<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"], #launchBtn, #controlsPanel button.btn'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    try {
      if (typeof window.__efieldApplyMode === 'function') window.__efieldApplyMode(state.mode);
    } catch (e) {}
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dual-mode-change', { detail: { mode: state.mode, attempts: state.attempts } }));
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || $('simCanvasArea') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap, #simCanvasArea')?.closest('#app, .main-layout') || document.querySelector('#simCanvasArea') || document.querySelector('#app');
    var bench = $('essence-bench') || $('controlsPanel');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if ($('modeSelect')) {
      // 页面已内置 modeSelect（如 controlsPanel）
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });
    var irrBtn = document.getElementById('I1');
    if (irrBtn) {
      irrBtn.addEventListener('change', function() {
        emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: irrBtn.value });
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function() {
    // ----- 物理常量 & canvas（像素尺寸跟舞台 + DPR，避免 CSS 拉伸糊） -----
    const canvas = document.getElementById('trackCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let W = 600, H = 320;
    let layout = null;
    // 提前声明：布局/停稳区几何随模式分流（syncCanvasSize 会读）
    let playMode = 'explore';

    function syncCanvasSize() {
        var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
        var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || canvas.clientWidth || 600);
        var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || canvas.clientHeight || 320);
        var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
        var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
        var bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
        if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) {
            canvas.width = bw;
            canvas.height = bh;
        }
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        W = cssW;
        H = cssH;
        // 布局随舞台：环路做大、占满视觉中心，左侧留给双模式条
        // 探究环略靠左以拉长停稳区；竞赛环略靠右+短停稳区，目视可辨且本局 Fixed
        var groundY = Math.round(H * 0.88);
        var loopRadius = Math.max(85, Math.min(155, Math.round(Math.min(W * 0.19, H * 0.26))));
        var loopCenterX = Math.round(W * (playMode === 'challenge' ? 0.60 : 0.50));
        var loopCenterY = groundY - loopRadius - 6;
        var loopTopY = loopCenterY - loopRadius;
        var startX = Math.max(168, Math.round(W * 0.24));
        // 环顶物理高度固定按 10 m 标定，使 h 滑条与视觉高度一一对应
        var metersPerPixel = 10 / Math.max(140, groundY - loopTopY);
        layout = { groundY, loopRadius, loopCenterX, loopCenterY, loopTopY, startX, metersPerPixel };
        return layout;
    }

    function startYForH(h) {
        var L = layout || syncCanvasSize();
        return L.groundY - h / L.metersPerPixel;
    }

    let carX = 0, carY = 0;
    let launched = false;
    let passedLoop = false;
    let simulationDone = false;
    let winOk = false;
    let hintKey = '';
    let animFailDrop = false;
    let animating = false;
    let carSparks = [];
    let winGlow = 0;
    let failGlow = 0;
    let testCount = 0;
    let sawPass = false;
    let sawFail = false;
    let exploreWon = false;
    let challengeWon = false;

    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '试车：对照减速带停靠远近',
        side: '调 h、v，看能否过环并停在减速带内。'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次过环并停在竞赛停稳区（本局固定）',
        side: '限次过环并停在竞赛停稳区（掉落/冲出都不换题）。'
      }
    };

    function refreshGoalUI() {
      const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
      if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
    }

    window.__mechApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      winOk = false;
      exploreWon = false;
      challengeWon = false;
      window.__legacyWinEmitted = false;
      testCount = 0;
      sawPass = false;
      sawFail = false;
      animating = false;
      if (btnFire) btnFire.disabled = false;
      if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        // 竞赛开局故意卡在「能量不够」：固定环路，考临界
        heightSlider.value = '4.0';
        speedSlider.value = '2.0';
      } else {
        heightSlider.value = '4.0';
        speedSlider.value = '2.0';
      }
      updateDisplays();
      resetSim();
      refreshGoalUI();
      observeText.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
        ? '夜场限次试车：竞赛停稳区与探究不同，本局固定；找合适能量翻过环顶并停稳'
        : '小车停在出发台 · 先自由试车，对照减速带停靠位置调参（竞赛停稳区另有布置）';
    };

    const heightSlider = document.getElementById('s-height');
    const speedSlider = document.getElementById('s-speed');
    const massSlider = document.getElementById('s-mass');
    const heightDisplay = document.getElementById('heightDisplay');
    const speedDisplay = document.getElementById('speedDisplay');
    const massDisplay = document.getElementById('massDisplay');
    const observeText = document.getElementById('observeText');
    const winMessage = document.getElementById('winMessage');
    const btnFire = document.getElementById('btn-fire');
    const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');

    function updateDisplays() {
        const h = parseFloat(heightSlider.value);
        const v = parseFloat(speedSlider.value);
        const m = parseFloat(massSlider.value);
        heightDisplay.textContent = h.toFixed(1) + ' m';
        speedDisplay.textContent = v.toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
        massDisplay.textContent = m.toFixed(1) + ' kg';
        if (!launched && !animating) {
            placeCarAtStart(h);
            drawTrack();
        }
    }
    heightSlider.addEventListener('input', updateDisplays);
    speedSlider.addEventListener('input', updateDisplays);
    massSlider.addEventListener('input', updateDisplays);

    function placeCarAtStart(h) {
        var L = layout || syncCanvasSize();
        carX = L.startX + 8;
        carY = startYForH(h) - 10;
    }

    // 成功带调参（典型舞台环顶视觉≈10m、R_m≈4.8–5.0）：
    // E0=g·h+½v²；过环需 E0≥E_top_min；地面 vg=√(2E0)。
    // 减速带恒定比能耗散：停距 s∝vg²，以 vMax=vGroundCrit·RATIO 恰对应停在带末端。
    // 成功：过环且最终停在减速带 [x0,x1] 内；失败：环上掉落，或冲出 x1 后在带外滑行停下。
    // 探究/竞赛分流：竞赛停稳区更短、上限 RATIO 更紧，同参未必两边同结论；本局 Fixed 不换长度。
    // 验证约：低能(h=4,v=2)掉落；中等(h≈6–8,v≈4–6)探究停中后段、竞赛更靠后或冲出；
    // (h=10,v=10)两边皆冲出。动画与判据共用同一减速模型，停靠位置连续可读。
    const LOOP_TOP_H_FACTOR = 0.55;
    const V_TOP_MIN_FACTOR = 0.6;
    // 探究：较长停稳区 + 较松上限；竞赛：明显更短 + 更紧上限（视觉与判据一致，约 2× 长度差）
    const BRAKE_MODE = {
        explore: { groundSpeedMaxRatio: 1.45, zoneFrac: 0.22, minLen: 130, rightPad: 52 },
        challenge: { groundSpeedMaxRatio: 1.20, zoneFrac: 0.09, minLen: 52, rightPad: 110 }
    };

    function brakeModeCfg() {
        return BRAKE_MODE[playMode] || BRAKE_MODE.explore;
    }

    function brakeZoneGeom(L) {
        var cfg = brakeModeCfg();
        var exitX = L.loopCenterX + L.loopRadius + 20;
        var x0 = exitX + 10;
        // 右侧预留冲出滑行；竞赛 rightPad 更大 → 停稳区更短且冲出仍可见
        var rightPad = cfg.rightPad != null ? cfg.rightPad : 96;
        var x1 = Math.min(W - rightPad, Math.max(x0 + cfg.minLen, exitX + Math.round(W * cfg.zoneFrac)));
        x1 = Math.min(x1, W - 40);
        if (x1 < x0 + 40) x1 = Math.min(W - 40, x0 + 40);
        // 停稳区 = 整条减速带 [x0,x1]；刻度仅供目视对照，不另设隐藏子区间
        return { exitX: exitX, x0: x0, x1: x1, len: Math.max(1, x1 - x0) };
    }

    function computePassLoop(h, v) {
        return computeRunOutcome(h, v).canLoop;
    }

    function computeRunOutcome(h, v) {
        var L = layout || syncCanvasSize();
        const loopTopHeight = (L.groundY - L.loopTopY) * L.metersPerPixel;
        const g = 9.8;
        const E0 = g * h + 0.5 * v * v;
        const loopRadiusM = L.loopRadius * L.metersPerPixel;
        const vTopMin = V_TOP_MIN_FACTOR * Math.sqrt(g * loopRadiusM);
        const E_top_min = g * loopTopHeight * LOOP_TOP_H_FACTOR + 0.5 * vTopMin * vTopMin;
        const canLoop = E0 >= E_top_min - 1e-9;
        const vGround = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 2 * E0));
        const vGroundCrit = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 2 * E_top_min));
        const vMax = vGroundCrit * brakeModeCfg().groundSpeedMaxRatio;
        // 停距分数：(vg/vMax)²；=1 恰停末端，>1 冲出
        const stopFrac = vMax > 1e-9 ? (vGround / vMax) * (vGround / vMax) : 0;
        const brake = brakeZoneGeom(L);
        const tooFast = canLoop && (stopFrac > 1 + 1e-9);
        var finalX = brake.x0 + Math.min(1, stopFrac) * brake.len;
        var overshootPx = 0;
        if (tooFast) {
            // 带外滑行预估（与动画 coastA≈0.42·aBrake 同构，仅作文案兜底）
            var leftFrac = Math.max(0, stopFrac - 1);
            overshootPx = Math.min(W - brake.x1 - 16, brake.len * leftFrac / 0.28);
            finalX = brake.x1 + overshootPx;
        }
        return {
            E0: E0,
            canLoop: canLoop,
            tooFast: tooFast,
            success: canLoop && !tooFast,
            vGround: vGround,
            vMax: vMax,
            E_top_min: E_top_min,
            stopFrac: stopFrac,
            finalX: finalX,
            overshootPx: overshootPx
        };
    }

    /** 根据最终车位给出目视向描述（不剧透公式） */
    function describeBrakeStop(carX, brake) {
        var len = Math.max(1, brake.x1 - brake.x0);
        if (carX <= brake.x1 + 2) {
            var t = (carX - brake.x0) / len;
            if (t < 0.34) return { kind: 'in', where: '前段', short: '停·前段' };
            if (t < 0.67) return { kind: 'in', where: '中段', short: '停·中段' };
            if (t < 0.9) return { kind: 'in', where: '后段', short: '停·后段' };
            return { kind: 'in', where: '末端附近', short: '停·末端' };
        }
        var past = carX - brake.x1;
        if (past < len * 0.18) return { kind: 'out', where: '刚冲出末端一点点', short: '冲出·一点点' };
        if (past < len * 0.45) return { kind: 'out', where: '冲出减速带一小段', short: '冲出·一小段' };
        return { kind: 'out', where: '明显冲出减速带', short: '冲出·较远' };
    }

    function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
        ctx.closePath();
    }

    function drawCar(x, y) {
        var m = massSlider ? parseFloat(massSlider.value) : 1.5;
        var s = 0.95 + Math.min(1.4, Math.max(0.5, m)) * 0.22;
        var SC = { ink: '#0c1218', mid: '#243040', hi: '#90b8e8', glow: '#4080d0', metal: '#6a7888', accent: '#5088c8' };
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x, y);
        ctx.scale(s, s);
        // 环轨小车加大
        var chassis = ctx.createLinearGradient(-20, 4, 20, 14);
        chassis.addColorStop(0, '#4a5564');
        chassis.addColorStop(0.5, SC.metal);
        chassis.addColorStop(1, '#3a4450');
        roundRect(-20, 2, 40, 12, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = chassis;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.accent;
        roundRect(-18, -16, 36, 20, 5);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.ink;
        ctx.fillRect(-12, -12, 10, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(2, -12, 10, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
        ctx.fillRect(-15, -14, 30, 4);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4450';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-11, 10, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(11, 10, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawTrack() {
        var L = syncCanvasSize();
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var groundY = L.groundY;
        var startX = L.startX;
        var loopCenterX = L.loopCenterX;
        var loopCenterY = L.loopCenterY;
        var loopRadius = L.loopRadius;
        var loopTopY = L.loopTopY;
        // 竖直圆环：进出点在环底（圆心正下方），非整圆开口朝下的上半拱
        var entryX = loopCenterX;
        var entryY = loopCenterY + loopRadius;
        var brake = brakeZoneGeom(L);
        var exitX = brake.exitX;
        var h = parseFloat(heightSlider.value);
        var sy = startYForH(h);

        var SC = { ink: '#0c1218', mid: '#243040', hi: '#90b8e8', glow: '#4080d0', metal: '#6a7888', accent: '#5088c8', ok: '#6fae8f' };

        // —— 环轨台：冷色钢架实验间 ——
        var bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
        bg.addColorStop(0, '#101820');
        bg.addColorStop(0.3, SC.ink);
        bg.addColorStop(0.65, '#0a1018');
        bg.addColorStop(1, '#080c12');
        ctx.fillStyle = bg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        var tNow = performance.now();
        var coolPulse = 0.9 + 0.1 * Math.sin(tNow * 0.0015);
        var spot = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.55, H * 0.05, 6, W * 0.5, groundY * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
        spot.addColorStop(0, `rgba(64,128,208,${0.18 * coolPulse})`);
        spot.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(80,136,200,${0.08 * coolPulse})`);
        spot.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,18,24,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = spot;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var spot2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.15, H * 0.08, 4, W * 0.2, H * 0.35, W * 0.3);
        spot2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(144,184,232,0.06)');
        spot2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,18,24,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = spot2;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        // 钢架桁条
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,136,0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (var tr = 0; tr < 5; tr++) {
            var tx = 30 + tr * (W / 5.5);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(tx, 20);
            ctx.lineTo(tx + 8, groundY - 30);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // 环轨台控制台
        var boothX = Math.max(16, startX - 100);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.mid;
        roundRect(boothX, groundY - 62, 56, 58, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('环轨台', boothX + 10, groundY - 72);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(144,184,232,0.25)';
        ctx.fillRect(boothX + 10, groundY - 48, 36, 14);

        // 工业围栏
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(8, groundY - 16);
        ctx.lineTo(W - 8, groundY - 16);
        ctx.stroke();
        for (var p = 8; p < W; p += 28) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(p, groundY - 16);
            ctx.lineTo(p, groundY);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // 钢质地坪
        var floor = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
        floor.addColorStop(0, '#3a4450');
        floor.addColorStop(0.5, SC.mid);
        floor.addColorStop(1, SC.ink);
        ctx.fillStyle = floor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,136,200,0.12)';
        for (var g = 0; g < 12; g++) ctx.fillRect(12 + g * 62, groundY + 10, 24, 2);

        // 出发平台高度随 h 绑定
        var deckW = 64, deckH = 12;
        var deckY = sy;
        // 钢架立柱
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(startX - 18, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(startX - 18, deckY);
        ctx.moveTo(startX + 28, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(startX + 28, deckY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(106,120,136,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            var yy = deckY + (groundY - deckY) * (k / 4);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(startX - 18, yy);
            ctx.lineTo(startX + 28, yy + 10);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.mid;
        roundRect(startX - 26, deckY - 2, deckW, deckH, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('出发台', startX - 18, deckY - 10);

        // 高度标尺（与滑条 h 视觉绑定）
        var rulerX = startX - 42;
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.glow;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(rulerX, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(rulerX, deckY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.font = '11px ui-monospace,Consolas,sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.82)';
        ctx.fillRect(rulerX - 10, Math.max(40, deckY - 30), 56, 18);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.fillText('h=' + h.toFixed(1) + 'm', rulerX - 8, Math.max(56, deckY - 16));

        // 环路支架
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(loopCenterX - loopRadius - 6, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(loopCenterX - loopRadius - 6, loopCenterY);
        ctx.moveTo(loopCenterX + loopRadius + 6, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(loopCenterX + loopRadius + 6, loopCenterY);
        ctx.moveTo(loopCenterX, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(loopCenterX, entryY);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 轨道：出发台 → 环底入环 → 竖直全环（过顶）→ 环底出环落地（加粗）
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.lineWidth = 7;
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(startX, sy);
        ctx.lineTo(entryX, entryY);
        // 两段半圆拼成竖直全环（避免起止角差恰为 2π 时部分浏览器不画）
        // 逆时针：环底→右侧→环顶→左侧→环底
        ctx.arc(loopCenterX, loopCenterY, loopRadius, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5, true);
        ctx.arc(loopCenterX, loopCenterY, loopRadius, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2, true);
        ctx.lineTo(brake.x1 + 8, groundY - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        // 轨枕高光
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(startX, sy - 3);
        ctx.lineTo(entryX, entryY - 3);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 减速带：出环后右侧地面（斑马纹理 + 停稳区刻度）
        var bz0 = brake.x0, bz1 = brake.x1, bzTop = groundY - 5, bzH = 12;
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.glow;
        ctx.fillRect(bz0, bzTop, bz1 - bz0, bzH);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.ink;
        for (var zx = bz0; zx < bz1; zx += 12) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(zx, bzTop);
            ctx.lineTo(Math.min(zx + 6, bz1), bzTop);
            ctx.lineTo(Math.min(zx + 12, bz1), bzTop + bzH);
            ctx.lineTo(Math.min(zx + 6, bz1), bzTop + bzH);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
        }
        // 四等分刻度：目视对照停在前/中/后/末端
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(254,243,199,0.95)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        for (var ti = 0; ti <= 4; ti++) {
            var tx = bz0 + (bz1 - bz0) * (ti / 4);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(tx, bzTop - 5);
            ctx.lineTo(tx, bzTop + bzH + 3);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeRect(bz0, bzTop, bz1 - bz0, bzH);
        // 成功/失败短暂光效（不改判据）
        if (winGlow > 0) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(111,174,143,${0.9 * Math.min(1, winGlow)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(bz0 - 3, bzTop - 4, bz1 - bz0 + 6, bzH + 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(111,174,143,${0.15 * Math.min(1, winGlow)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bz0 - 3, bzTop - 4, bz1 - bz0 + 6, bzH + 8);
        } else if (failGlow > 0) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(248,113,113,${0.8 * Math.min(1, failGlow)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            ctx.setLineDash([5, 3]);
            ctx.strokeRect(bz1 - 6, bzTop - 8, 18, bzH + 16);
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
        // 末端竖标：冲出时对照「差多少」
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e06060';
        ctx.fillRect(bz1 - 2, bzTop - 10, 3, bzH + 14);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.82)';
        ctx.fillRect((bz0 + bz1) / 2 - 30, bzTop - 20, 60, 14);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('停稳区', (bz0 + bz1) / 2 - 18, bzTop - 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.75)';
        ctx.fillRect(bz1 - 22, bzTop - 34, 40, 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e8a0a0';
        ctx.font = '10px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('末端', bz1 - 12, bzTop - 24);

        // 最高点标记
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e08080';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(loopCenterX, loopTopY, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.82)';
        ctx.fillRect(loopCenterX - 18, loopTopY - 26, 36, 16);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('环顶', loopCenterX - 14, loopTopY - 12);

        // 读数徽章
        var badgeX = Math.min(W - 140, Math.max(brake.x0, brake.x1 - 110));
        var badgeY = groundY - 72;
        roundRect(badgeX, badgeY, 118, 36, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,24,0.88)';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,136,200,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace,Consolas,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('v₀ = ' + parseFloat(speedSlider.value).toFixed(1) + ' m/s', badgeX + 12, badgeY + 22);

        if (!launched && !animating && !simulationDone) {
            placeCarAtStart(h);
        }
        // 结束后保留动画停靠的真实车位（连续位移），不再吸附到固定点

        // 运行火花尾迹
        for (var si = carSparks.length - 1; si >= 0; si--) {
            var sp = carSparks[si];
            sp.x += sp.vx;
            sp.y += sp.vy;
            sp.life -= 0.04;
            if (sp.life <= 0) { carSparks.splice(si, 1); continue; }
            ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, sp.life);
            ctx.fillStyle = sp.col || (sp.hot ? SC.hi : SC.glow);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sp.x, sp.y, sp.r || 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

        drawCar(carX, carY);
        if (winGlow > 0) winGlow = Math.max(0, winGlow - 0.02);
        if (failGlow > 0) failGlow = Math.max(0, failGlow - 0.02);
    }

    function resetSim() {
        launched = false;
        simulationDone = false;
        winOk = false;
        hintKey = '';
        passedLoop = false;
        animFailDrop = false;
        animating = false;
        placeCarAtStart(parseFloat(heightSlider.value));
        observeText.textContent = '小车停在出发台 · 尚未过环，调 h / v 后再发射';
        winMessage.innerHTML = '';
        drawTrack();
    }

    function maybeModeWin(success, failKind) {
        const emitFn = window.__emit || window.emit;
        const controlsSnapshot = {
          's-height': heightSlider.value,
          's-speed': speedSlider.value
        };
        if (playMode === 'challenge') {
          if (!success) {
            var failHint = failKind === 'fly' ? 'fail_speed' : 'fail_energy';
            if (emitFn) emitFn('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: failHint });
            return;
          }
          if (challengeWon) return;
          challengeWon = true;
          winOk = true;
          hintKey = 'rush_loop';
          winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">夜场试车成功</span>';
          if (emitFn) {
            emitFn('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey });
            emitFn('win', { winOk: true });
          }
          if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
            window.__craftShowWin('限次试车中，你把机械能调到合适区间，车厢翻过了固定环顶并停在减速带内。');
          }
          return;
        }
        // 探究：必须同时见过成功与失败（掉落或冲出减速带皆算失败体验），才算摸清临界
        if (exploreWon) return;
        if (testCount < 3 || !sawPass || !sawFail) {
          var partialHint = success ? 'pass_partial' : (failKind === 'fly' ? 'fail_speed_partial' : 'fail_partial');
          if (emitFn) emitFn('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: partialHint });
          return;
        }
        exploreWon = true;
        winOk = true;
        hintKey = 'critical_explored';
        winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">探究完成</span>';
        if (emitFn) {
          emitFn('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey });
          emitFn('win', { winOk: true });
        }
        if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
          window.__craftShowWin('你通过对照掉落、减速带内不同停靠位置与冲出带外，归纳出了合适的机械能区间。');
        }
    }

    function heightMetersAtY(y, L) {
        return Math.max(0, (L.groundY - y) * L.metersPerPixel);
    }

    function heightMetersAtLoopAngle(angle, L) {
        var y = L.loopCenterY + L.loopRadius * Math.sin(angle);
        return heightMetersAtY(y, L);
    }

    // 动画用有效高度：与过环门槛的环顶折减一致，避免「判据已过环但环顶动能归零卡死」
    function animHeightM(heightM) {
        return heightM * LOOP_TOP_H_FACTOR;
    }

    function speedFromEnergy(E0, heightM, g) {
        var ke = E0 - g * heightM;
        return ke > 1e-6 ? Math.sqrt(2 * ke) : 0;
    }

    function setCarOnLoop(L, angle) {
        carX = L.loopCenterX + L.loopRadius * Math.cos(angle);
        carY = L.loopCenterY + L.loopRadius * Math.sin(angle);
    }

    function finishFire(h, v, outcome) {
        var success = outcome.success;
        var failKind = success ? '' : (outcome.tooFast ? 'fly' : 'drop');
        var Ldone = layout || syncCanvasSize();
        var brakeDone = brakeZoneGeom(Ldone);
        // 最终停靠与连续模型对齐（动画过程连续减速，落点按 stopFrac / 冲出距）
        if (success) {
            carX = brakeDone.x0 + Math.min(0.999, Math.max(0, outcome.stopFrac)) * brakeDone.len;
            carY = Ldone.groundY - 12;
        } else if (failKind === 'fly') {
            var pastPx = Math.max(16, Math.min(outcome.overshootPx, Math.max(24, W - brakeDone.x1 - 16)));
            carX = brakeDone.x1 + pastPx;
            carY = Ldone.groundY - 12;
        }
        var stopDesc = failKind === 'drop' ? null : describeBrakeStop(carX, brakeDone);
        passedLoop = success;
        simulationDone = true;
        launched = true;
        animating = false;
        animFailDrop = failKind === 'drop';
        testCount += 1;
        if (success) sawPass = true; else sawFail = true;
        if (success) {
            winGlow = 1.0;
            failGlow = 0;
            observeText.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
              ? ('过山车翻过环顶，停在减速带' + stopDesc.where + '。夜场试车达标。')
              : ('过山车停在减速带' + stopDesc.where + '。可对照刻度微调，或再试掉落 / 冲出。');
            winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">' + stopDesc.short + '</span>';
            hintKey = 'pass';
        } else if (failKind === 'fly') {
            failGlow = 1.25;
            winGlow = 0;
            // 冲出：更多火花、偏橙红
            for (var fi = 0; fi < 14; fi++) {
              carSparks.push({
                x: carX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18,
                y: carY - Math.random() * 10,
                vx: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
                vy: -1 - Math.random() * 3,
                life: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.5,
                r: 2 + Math.random() * 2.5,
                hot: true,
                col: 'rgba(255,140,80,0.9)'
              });
            }
            observeText.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
              ? ('过环后' + stopDesc.where + '。轨道不变，试着略降能量再停进带内。')
              : ('过环后' + stopDesc.where + '。对照末端红标看冲出多远，再略降 h 或 v。');
            winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="fail-badge" style="background:#ea580c;">过环·冲出减速带</span>';
            hintKey = 'fail_speed';
        } else {
            failGlow = 0.95;
            winGlow = 0;
            // 掉落：少量暗红火花、下坠感
            for (var di = 0; di < 8; di++) {
              carSparks.push({
                x: carX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
                y: carY + Math.random() * 8,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
                vy: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
                life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4,
                r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
                hot: false,
                col: 'rgba(220,80,80,0.85)'
              });
            }
            observeText.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
              ? '未能过环。轨道不变，继续调参再试。'
              : '掉落了。能量不够过环顶，先加大再观察减速带停靠。';
            winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="fail-badge" style="background:#b91c1c;">未过环·掉落</span>';
            hintKey = 'fail_energy';
        }
        drawTrack();
        maybeModeWin(success, failKind);
        // 光效衰减刷新（待机也续画旗帜闪烁）
        (function fadeFx() {
            if (animating) return;
            if (winGlow > 0 || failGlow > 0 || carSparks.length) {
                drawTrack();
                requestAnimationFrame(fadeFx);
            }
        })();
    }

    function fire() {
        if (animating) return;
        const h = parseFloat(heightSlider.value);
        const v = parseFloat(speedSlider.value);
        if (h < 0 || h > 10 || v < 0 || v > 10) {
            observeText.textContent = '参数超出范围 (h:0~10, v:0~10)';
            winMessage.innerHTML = '<span class="fail-badge">参数无效</span>';
            return;
        }
        var L = syncCanvasSize();
        const outcome = computeRunOutcome(h, v);
        simulationDone = false;
        launched = true;
        animating = true;
        animFailDrop = !outcome.canLoop;
        observeText.textContent = '过山车运行中…';
        winMessage.innerHTML = '';
        const gPhys = 9.8;
        const E0 = outcome.E0;
        const loopRadiusM = L.loopRadius * L.metersPerPixel;
        const ANIM_SCALE = 3.4;
        const entryX = L.loopCenterX;
        const entryY = L.loopCenterY + L.loopRadius;
        const brake = brakeZoneGeom(L);
        const sx0 = L.startX + 8;
        const sy0 = startYForH(h) - 10;
        const rampLenPx = Math.hypot(entryX - sx0, (entryY - 8) - sy0);
        const runoutLenPx = Math.max(1, brake.x0 - entryX);
        const brakeLenPx = Math.max(40, brake.x1 - brake.x0);
        let phase = 'ramp';
        let rampS = 0;
        let loopAngle = Math.PI / 2;
        let runoutS = 0;
        let dropVy = 0;
        // 减速带连续减速：进入时赋初速，a 使 vMax 恰在末端刹停
        let brakeVel = 0;
        let brakeA = 0;
        let coastA = 0;
        let lastTs = null;
        function animFrame(ts) {
            if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
            var dt = Math.min(0.032, (ts - lastTs) / 1000);
            lastTs = ts;
            if (phase === 'ramp') {
                var hm = animHeightM(heightMetersAtY(sy0 + (entryY - 8 - sy0) * (rampS / rampLenPx) + 10, L));
                var spd = Math.max(0.35, speedFromEnergy(E0, hm, gPhys));
                rampS += spd * ANIM_SCALE * dt / L.metersPerPixel;
                if (rampS >= rampLenPx) {
                    rampS = rampLenPx;
                    // 能量够过顶：走完整环再进减速带；能量不够：中途掉落
                    phase = outcome.canLoop ? 'loop' : 'loop_fail';
                    loopAngle = Math.PI / 2;
                }
                var ru = rampS / rampLenPx;
                carX = sx0 + (entryX - sx0) * ru;
                carY = sy0 + (entryY - 8 - sy0) * ru;
            } else if (phase === 'loop') {
                var hmLoop = animHeightM(heightMetersAtLoopAngle(loopAngle, L));
                var spdLoop = Math.max(0.45, speedFromEnergy(E0, hmLoop, gPhys));
                loopAngle -= (spdLoop * ANIM_SCALE * dt) / loopRadiusM;
                if (loopAngle <= Math.PI / 2 - Math.PI * 2 + 0.015) {
                    loopAngle = Math.PI / 2 - Math.PI * 2;
                    phase = 'runout';
                    runoutS = 0;
                }
                if (phase === 'loop') setCarOnLoop(L, loopAngle);
            } else if (phase === 'loop_fail') {
                var hmFail = animHeightM(heightMetersAtLoopAngle(loopAngle, L));
                var spdFail = speedFromEnergy(E0, hmFail, gPhys);
                setCarOnLoop(L, loopAngle);
                if (spdFail < 0.4 && loopAngle < Math.PI / 2 - 0.12) {
                    phase = 'drop';
                    dropVy = 0;
                } else {
                    loopAngle -= (Math.max(spdFail, 0.15) * ANIM_SCALE * dt) / loopRadiusM;
                    if (loopAngle <= -Math.PI / 2 + 0.06) {
                        loopAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + 0.06;
                        phase = 'drop';
                        dropVy = 0;
                    }
                }
            } else if (phase === 'drop') {
                dropVy += 520 * dt;
                carY += dropVy * dt;
                carX -= 32 * dt;
                if (carY >= L.groundY - 12) {
                    carY = L.groundY - 12;
                    phase = 'done';
                }
            } else if (phase === 'runout') {
                // 出环落地 → 驶入减速带起点
                var hmRun = animHeightM(heightMetersAtY(L.groundY - 12, L));
                var spdRun = Math.max(0.8, speedFromEnergy(E0, hmRun, gPhys));
                runoutS += spdRun * ANIM_SCALE * dt / L.metersPerPixel;
                var ru2 = Math.min(1, runoutS / runoutLenPx);
                carX = entryX + (brake.x0 - entryX) * ru2;
                carY = L.groundY - 12;
                if (ru2 >= 1) {
                    phase = 'brake';
                    var hmBr0 = animHeightM(heightMetersAtY(L.groundY - 12, L));
                    var vEnter = Math.max(0.35, speedFromEnergy(E0, hmBr0, gPhys));
                    brakeVel = vEnter * ANIM_SCALE / L.metersPerPixel;
                    var vMaxPx = outcome.vMax * ANIM_SCALE / L.metersPerPixel;
                    // a = vMax²/(2L)：恰使临界最大速停在带末端；更大动能则冲出
                    brakeA = (vMaxPx * vMaxPx) / (2 * brakeLenPx);
                    // 带外减速度更小，冲出距离更易目视分辨「差一点 / 明显过冲」
                    coastA = brakeA * 0.28;
                }
            } else if (phase === 'brake') {
                // 同一套连续减速：用剩余刹停距判断停带内或冲出，避免欧拉积分误判
                carY = L.groundY - 12;
                var xOld = carX;
                var stopLeft = brakeA > 1e-9 ? (brakeVel * brakeVel) / (2 * brakeA) : 0;
                if (xOld + stopLeft <= brake.x1 + 0.75) {
                    // 动能将在带内耗尽 → 滑行至停点
                    var step = Math.min(brakeVel * dt, stopLeft);
                    carX = xOld + step;
                    brakeVel = Math.max(0, brakeVel - brakeA * dt);
                    if (brakeVel <= 1e-3 || step >= stopLeft - 1e-3) {
                        carX = Math.min(xOld + stopLeft, brake.x1);
                        brakeVel = 0;
                        phase = 'done';
                    }
                } else {
                    // 到末端仍有较大剩余动能 → 出带
                    carX = xOld + brakeVel * dt;
                    if (carX >= brake.x1) {
                        var distEnd = Math.max(0, brake.x1 - xOld);
                        brakeVel = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, brakeVel * brakeVel - 2 * brakeA * distEnd));
                        carX = brake.x1;
                        phase = 'coast';
                    } else {
                        brakeVel = Math.max(0, brakeVel - brakeA * dt);
                    }
                }
            } else if (phase === 'coast') {
                // 冲出带端后沿地面继续滑行（目视可读冲出远近；不做卡通抛飞）
                carY = L.groundY - 12;
                var coastStop = coastA > 1e-9 ? (brakeVel * brakeVel) / (2 * coastA) : 0;
                var cstep = Math.min(brakeVel * dt, coastStop);
                carX += cstep;
                brakeVel = Math.max(0, brakeVel - coastA * dt);
                if (brakeVel <= 1e-3 || cstep >= coastStop - 1e-3 || carX >= W - 16) {
                    carX = Math.min(carX, W - 16);
                    if (brakeVel <= 1e-3 || cstep >= coastStop - 1e-3) {
                        // 停在带外真实滑行终点
                    }
                    brakeVel = 0;
                    phase = 'done';
                }
            }
            // 运动火花（环底更快时更密）
            if (phase === 'loop' || phase === 'ramp' || phase === 'runout' || phase === 'brake' || phase === 'coast') {
                if (Math.random() < 0.55) {
                    carSparks.push({
                        x: carX - 4 + Math.random() * 6,
                        y: carY + 4,
                        vx: -0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4,
                        vy: -0.3 + Math.random() * 0.6,
                        life: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3,
                        r: 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.6,
                        hot: phase === 'loop' || phase === 'brake'
                    });
                    if (carSparks.length > 40) carSparks.shift();
                }
            }
            drawTrack();
            if (phase !== 'done') requestAnimationFrame(animFrame);
            else finishFire(h, v, outcome);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    }

    refreshGoalUI();
    btnFire.addEventListener('click', fire);
    btnReset.addEventListener('click', resetSim);

    updateDisplays();
    resetSim();
    window.__mechRedraw = drawTrack;
    // 待机彩旗/串灯微动（不改玩法）
    (function ambientMech() {
        if (!animating) drawTrack();
        requestAnimationFrame(ambientMech);
    })();

    if (typeof window.emit === 'undefined') {
        window.emit = function(type, payload) {
            try {
                if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                    window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
                    return;
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            try {
                if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                    window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        };
    }

})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__essenceStageResize) return;
  window.__essenceStageResize = true;
  function fit(){
    if (typeof window.__mechRedraw === 'function') {
      window.__mechRedraw();
      return;
    }
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    var cvs = stage && stage.querySelector('canvas');
    if (!stage || !cvs) return;
    var w = stage.clientWidth, h = stage.clientHeight;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2) return;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__mechApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__mechApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>


<script>
/* === craft-gold-runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__craftGold) return; window.__craftGold = true;
  var intro = document.getElementById('craft-intro');
  var win = document.getElementById('craft-win');
  var btn = document.getElementById('craftIntroBtn');
  var wbtn = document.getElementById('craftWinBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(intro) intro.hidden = true; });
  function replayLevel(){
    if (typeof window.__craftReplay === 'function') {
      try { window.__craftReplay(); return; } catch (e) {}
    }
    var rbtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset')
      || document.querySelector('#btnReset, button.btn-reset, [data-action="reset"]');
    if (rbtn) { try { rbtn.click(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  if (wbtn) wbtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    window.__craftWinDismissed = true;
    if (win) win.hidden = true;
    replayLevel();
  });

  // gauge into hud
  var hud = document.getElementById('essence-hud') || document.getElementById('dual-mode-hud') || document.getElementById('hud');
  if (hud && !document.getElementById('craft-gauge')) {
    var g = document.createElement('div');
    g.id = 'craft-gauge';
    g.innerHTML = '<span>目标仪表</span><strong id="craftGaugeVal">待测</strong>';
    hud.appendChild(g);
  }
function showWin(extra){
