<script>
    (function() {
        const A_PHYS = 0.05;   // 真正进入热流计算的截面积（学生可调的 A 为对照量）
        const d = 0.02;
        let TARGET_Q = 2000;
        let TARGET_Q_HI = 3200;
        let playMode = 'explore';
        let lockedQ = null;
        let lockedQHi = null;
        let challengeWon = false;

        const kSlider = document.getElementById('s-thermal-conductivity');
        const dtSlider = document.getElementById('s-temperature-diff');
        const aSlider = document.getElementById('s-area');
        const kVal = document.getElementById('k-value');
        const dtVal = document.getElementById('dt-value');
        const aVal = document.getElementById('a-value');
        const heatDisplay = document.getElementById('heat-rate-display');
        const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-message');
        const winArea = document.getElementById('win-area');
        const canvas = document.getElementById('heatCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const testBtn = document.getElementById('btn-test');
        const resetBtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset');

        let W = 600, H = 320, animT = 0, ambientT = 0;
        /** 事件动画 FSM：idle(null) | windup | peak | settle；点击时冻结 drivers */
        let eventAnim = null;
        let rafLastTs = 0;
        /** 仅「测试热流」后揭示精确 Q；调参中显示待测 */
        let measuredQ = null;

        function computeBand(Q) {
            if (playMode !== 'challenge') {
                if (Q > TARGET_Q_HI) return 'high';
                if (Q >= TARGET_Q && Q <= TARGET_Q_HI) return 'ok';
                return 'low';
            }
            if (Q >= TARGET_Q && Q <= TARGET_Q_HI) return 'ok';
            if (Q > TARGET_Q_HI) return 'high';
            return 'low';
        }

        function mapQToDur(Q) {
            const q = Math.max(200, Math.min(5000, Q || 200));
            return Math.max(0.4, Math.min(1.5, 0.42 + (q / 5000) * 1.08));
        }

        function startEventAnim(k, dt, Q, aUi, band) {
            const totalDur = mapQToDur(Q);
            eventAnim = {
                phase: 'windup',
                t: 0,
                drivers: {
                    k: k, dt: dt, Q: Q, aUi: aUi, band: band,
                    surgeAmp: Math.min(1, Q / 5000),
                    totalDur: totalDur
                }
            };
        }

        function getEventPhaseDurs() {
            if (!eventAnim) return { windupDur: 0.2, peakDur: 0.12, settleDur: 0.3 };
            const d = eventAnim.drivers;
            const windupDur = Math.max(0.12, d.totalDur * 0.28);
            const peakDur = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.18, d.totalDur * 0.15));
            const settleDur = Math.max(0.15, d.totalDur - windupDur - peakDur);
            return { windupDur: windupDur, peakDur: peakDur, settleDur: settleDur };
        }

        function stepEventAnim(dt) {
            if (!eventAnim) return;
            eventAnim.t += dt;
            const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') {
                if (eventAnim.t >= ph.windupDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'peak'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
            } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') {
                if (eventAnim.t >= ph.peakDur) { eventAnim.phase = 'settle'; eventAnim.t = 0; }
            } else if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') {
                if (eventAnim.t >= ph.settleDur) eventAnim = null;
            }
        }

        function getEventSurge() {
            if (!eventAnim) return 0;
            const d = eventAnim.drivers;
            const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'windup') {
                return Math.min(1, eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, ph.windupDur)) * d.surgeAmp;
            }
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') return d.surgeAmp;
            return d.surgeAmp * Math.exp(-eventAnim.t * 2.6);
        }

        function getBandFlash() {
            if (!eventAnim) return 0;
            const ph = getEventPhaseDurs();
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'peak') return 1 - eventAnim.t / Math.max(0.05, ph.peakDur);
            if (eventAnim.phase === 'settle') return Math.max(0, 0.55 - eventAnim.t * 0.75);
            return 0;
        }

        const MODE_GOALS = {
          explore: {
            hud: '调导热与温差，观察穿墙热流',
            side: '调导热与温差，看穿墙热流怎么变。'
          },
          challenge: {
            hud: '限次把热流调进本局安全带',
            side: '限次把热流调进本局安全带（不足/过热都不换标）。'
          }
        };

        function refreshHeatGoals() {
          const g = MODE_GOALS[playMode] || MODE_GOALS.explore;
          const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
          const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
          if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedQ != null) {
            if (mission) mission.textContent = '急单安全带 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W · 本局固定';
            if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：限次把穿墙热流调进 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W（本局固定；不足或过热都不换标）。';
          } else {
            if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
            if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
          }
        }

        /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次热流安全带（含上界，避免拉满稳赢） */
        function lockChallengeQ() {
          lockedQ = 1600 + Math.round(Math.random() * 12) * 100; // 1600–2800
          TARGET_Q = lockedQ;
          // 带宽约 500–800，明显窄于探究 1200，同参未必两边同结论
          lockedQHi = TARGET_Q + 500 + Math.round(Math.random() * 3) * 100;
          TARGET_Q_HI = lockedQHi;
          challengeWon = false;
          measuredQ = null;
          kSlider.value = '25';
          dtSlider.value = '20';
          aSlider.value = '0.05';
          refreshHeatGoals();
          updateReadings();
          feedback.innerHTML = '急单已锁定热流安全带 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W（本局不变）· 调参后点测试';
          winArea.innerHTML = '';
        }

        function applyExploreQ() {
          lockedQ = null;
          lockedQHi = null;
          challengeWon = false;
          measuredQ = null;
          TARGET_Q = 2000;
          TARGET_Q_HI = 3200;
          kSlider.value = '25';
          dtSlider.value = '20';
          aSlider.value = '0.05';
          refreshHeatGoals();
          updateReadings();
          feedback.innerHTML = '自由试调 · 改导热或温差后点「测试热流」对比（不剧透瓦数）';
          winArea.innerHTML = '';
        }

        window.__heatApplyMode = function(mode) {
          playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
          if (playMode === 'challenge') lockChallengeQ();
          else applyExploreQ();
        };
/* BATCH6-FIXED-20260724 FixedChallenge */

        function syncCanvasSize() {
            var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
            var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || canvas.clientWidth || 600);
            var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || canvas.clientHeight || 320);
            var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
            canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
            canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
            var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr), bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
            if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) {
                canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh;
            }
            ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
            W = cssW; H = cssH;
        }

        function computeHeatRate(k, deltaT) {
            return (k * A_PHYS * deltaT) / d;
        }

        function updateReadings() {
            const k = parseFloat(kSlider.value);
            const dt = parseFloat(dtSlider.value);
            const aUi = parseFloat(aSlider.value);
            kVal.textContent = k.toFixed(1);
            dtVal.textContent = dt;
            if (aVal) aVal.textContent = aUi.toFixed(2);
            const Qlive = computeHeatRate(k, dt);
            if (measuredQ == null) {
                heatDisplay.textContent = '—';
            } else {
                heatDisplay.textContent = measuredQ.toFixed(2);
            }
            // 舞台粒子强度可随参定性变化，精确瓦数仅测后揭示
            drawCanvas(k, dt, Qlive, aUi, measuredQ);
        }

        function drawCanvas(k, dt, Qlive, aUi, Qshown) {
            syncCanvasSize();
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
            const INK = '#140c0c', MID = '#342020', HI = '#f0a090', GLOW = '#ff6040';
            const METAL = '#8a7870', PANEL = '#241616', ACCENT = '#e07060', OK = '#6fae8f';
            const drv = eventAnim ? eventAnim.drivers : null;
            if (drv) {
                k = drv.k; dt = drv.dt; Qlive = drv.Q; aUi = drv.aUi;
            }
            const surge = getEventSurge();
            const bandFlash = getBandFlash();
            const band = drv ? drv.band : null;
            const timeBase = eventAnim ? animT : ambientT;
            const intensity = Math.min(Qlive / 5000, 1);
            const dtNorm = Math.min(1, dt / 80);
            const coolFactor = Math.min(1, (1 - intensity) * 0.55 + dtNorm * 0.35);

            const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
            bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1010');
            bg.addColorStop(0.45, MID);
            bg.addColorStop(1, INK);
            ctx.fillStyle = bg;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            // FAR: 天花板横管 + 悬吊 IR 灯罩（y=8–50 避 TL HUD）
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(28,20,18,0.75)';
            for (let p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
              const py = 10 + p * 13;
              ctx.fillRect(W * 0.08, py, W * 0.84, 7);
              ctx.fillStyle = METAL;
              ctx.fillRect(W * 0.06, py - 2, 10, 11);
              ctx.fillRect(W * 0.9, py - 2, 10, 11);
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(28,20,18,0.75)';
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(36,28,24,0.88)';
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.36, 8, W * 0.28, 20);
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.42, 28, 5, 16);
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.51, 28, 5, 16);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,60,50,0.35)';
            ctx.strokeRect(W * 0.36, 8, W * 0.28, 20);

            const lamp = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.05, 8, W * 0.5, H * 0.05, W * 0.6);
            lamp.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,96,64,' + (0.06 + intensity * 0.24) + ')');
            lamp.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,96,64,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = lamp;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            const benchY = H - 52;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1008';
            ctx.fillRect(0, benchY + 4, W, 52);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2e2014';
            ctx.fillRect(0, benchY, W, 52);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3524';
            ctx.fillRect(0, benchY, W, 12);

            // 砖墙/管道墙（吃上空，避开 TL）
            for (let by = 118; by < H * 0.32; by += 18) {
              for (let bx = 0; bx < W; bx += 36) {
                const ox = ((by / 18) | 0) % 2 ? 18 : 0;
                ctx.fillStyle = (bx + by) % 72 < 36 ? '#2a1816' : '#241410';
                ctx.fillRect(bx + ox, by, 34, 16);
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,40,32,0.45)';
                ctx.strokeRect(bx + ox, by, 34, 16);
              }
            }
            // 竖管剪影
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2a28';
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.08, 120, 14, H * 0.22);
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.9, 120, 14, H * 0.22);
            ctx.fillStyle = METAL;
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.08 - 4, 120, 22, 8);
            ctx.fillRect(W * 0.9 - 4, 120, 22, 8);

            const rodY = H * 0.48, rodH = Math.max(22, H * 0.09);
            const rodX0 = W * 0.22, rodX1 = W * 0.74, rodLen = rodX1 - rodX0;

            // 炉膛体积
            const srcW = W * 0.16, srcH = H * 0.36;
            const srcX = W * 0.04, srcY = rodY - srcH * 0.42;
            const srcG = ctx.createLinearGradient(srcX, srcY, srcX + srcW, srcY + srcH);
            srcG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,96,64,${0.6 + intensity * 0.35})`);
            srcG.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(200,50,20,${0.45 + intensity * 0.3})`);
            srcG.addColorStop(1, `rgba(80,24,16,${0.5 + intensity * 0.2})`);
            ctx.fillStyle = srcG;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(srcX + 8, srcY);
            ctx.lineTo(srcX + srcW, srcY + 12);
            ctx.lineTo(srcX + srcW, srcY + srcH - 12);
            ctx.lineTo(srcX + 8, srcY + srcH);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = ACCENT;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            ctx.stroke();
            // 炉口火光
            const fireG = ctx.createRadialGradient(srcX + srcW * 0.7, rodY, 4, srcX + srcW * 0.7, rodY, srcW * 0.7);
            fireG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,180,80,${0.55 + intensity * 0.4})`);
            fireG.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,80,40,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = fireG;
            ctx.fillRect(srcX, srcY, srcW + 20, srcH);
            for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,160,120,${0.28 + intensity * 0.4})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(srcX + srcW * 0.65, rodY, 10 + c * 6 + Math.sin(timeBase * 3 + c) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = HI;
            ctx.font = 'bold 13px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('炉膛', srcX + 14, srcY - 8);

            // 散热翅片冷端
            const sinkW = W * 0.14, sinkH = H * 0.32;
            const sinkX = W * 0.78, sinkY = rodY - sinkH * 0.38;
            const sinkG = ctx.createLinearGradient(sinkX, sinkY, sinkX + sinkW, sinkY + sinkH);
            const sR0 = Math.round(90 - coolFactor * 35);
            const sG0 = Math.round(136 + coolFactor * 45);
            const sB0 = Math.round(128 + coolFactor * 55);
            const sR1 = Math.round(58 - coolFactor * 22);
            const sG1 = Math.round(68 + coolFactor * 38);
            const sB1 = Math.round(72 + coolFactor * 48);
            sinkG.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(' + sR0 + ',' + sG0 + ',' + sB0 + ')');
            sinkG.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(' + sR1 + ',' + sG1 + ',' + sB1 + ')');
            ctx.fillStyle = sinkG;
            ctx.fillRect(sinkX, sinkY, sinkW * 0.45, sinkH);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,150,210,' + (coolFactor * 0.22) + ')';
            ctx.fillRect(sinkX, sinkY, sinkW * 0.45, sinkH);
            for (let f = 0; f < 7; f++) {
              const fy = sinkY + 6 + f * (sinkH - 12) / 6;
              const finR = Math.round(106 - coolFactor * 40);
              const finG = Math.round(120 + coolFactor * 50);
              const finB = Math.round(112 + coolFactor * 55);
              ctx.fillStyle = f % 2 ? 'rgb(' + finR + ',' + finG + ',' + finB + ')' : 'rgb(' + (finR + 20) + ',' + (finG + 24) + ',' + (finB + 18) + ')';
              ctx.fillRect(sinkX + sinkW * 0.4, fy, sinkW * 0.55, 8);
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = METAL;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(sinkX, sinkY, sinkW * 0.45, sinkH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#a09078';
            ctx.font = 'bold 13px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('散热端', sinkX + 4, sinkY - 8);

            // 粗导热棒（≥8%H）+ 管套
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3028';
            ctx.fillRect(rodX0 - 6, rodY - rodH / 2 - 6, rodLen + 12, rodH + 12);
            const irG = ctx.createLinearGradient(rodX0, 0, rodX1, 0);
            irG.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,96,64,${0.8 + intensity * 0.2})`);
            irG.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(240,160,120,${0.5 + intensity * 0.35})`);
            irG.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(180,120,100,${0.3 + intensity * 0.2})`);
            irG.addColorStop(1, `rgba(120,100,96,${0.18 + intensity * 0.1})`);
            const rodMetal = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, rodY - rodH / 2, 0, rodY + rodH / 2);
            rodMetal.addColorStop(0, '#b8a898');
            rodMetal.addColorStop(0.5, METAL);
            rodMetal.addColorStop(1, '#5a5048');
            ctx.fillStyle = rodMetal;
            ctx.fillRect(rodX0, rodY - rodH / 2, rodLen, rodH);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + intensity * 0.35;
            ctx.fillStyle = irG;
            ctx.fillRect(rodX0, rodY - rodH / 2, rodLen, rodH);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,160,144,0.55)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(rodX0, rodY - rodH / 2, rodLen, rodH);
            ctx.fillStyle = HI;
            ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('导热棒 · IR 示意', rodX0, rodY - rodH / 2 - 12);

            const n = Math.max(8, Math.round((8 + intensity * 12) * (eventAnim ? (1 + surge * 2.5) : 1)));
            const flowSpeed = eventAnim ? (0.55 + intensity * 0.85 + surge * 1.6) : (0.35 + intensity * 0.6);
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                const t = (timeBase * flowSpeed + i / n) % 1;
                const x = rodX0 + t * rodLen;
                const y = rodY + Math.sin(timeBase * 2 + i) * (rodH * 0.45);
                let pr = 3 + intensity * 2.5 + surge * 3;
                let pR = 255, pG = 96, pB = 64;
                if (band === 'ok' && bandFlash > 0) {
                    pR = Math.round(pR + (111 - pR) * bandFlash * 0.55);
                    pG = Math.round(pG + (174 - pG) * bandFlash * 0.55);
                    pB = Math.round(pB + (143 - pB) * bandFlash * 0.55);
                } else if (band === 'high' && bandFlash > 0) {
                    pR = Math.round(pR + (255 - pR) * bandFlash * 0.35);
                    pG = Math.round(pG + (40 - pG) * bandFlash * 0.4);
                    pB = Math.round(pB + (40 - pB) * bandFlash * 0.35);
                }
                const alpha = 0.3 + intensity * 0.65 + surge * 0.25;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + pR + ',' + pG + ',' + pB + ',' + alpha + ')';
                ctx.shadowColor = band === 'ok' && bandFlash > 0 ? OK : GLOW;
                ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + intensity * 8 + surge * 14;
                ctx.arc(x, y, pr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }

            const boxW = 250, boxH = 52, boxX = W - boxW - 16, boxY = H - boxH - 68;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(36,22,22,0.9)';
            ctx.fillRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
            ctx.strokeStyle = intensity >= 0.4 ? 'rgba(255,96,64,0.55)' : 'rgba(224,112,96,0.4)';
            ctx.strokeRect(boxX, boxY, boxW, boxH);
            ctx.fillStyle = HI;
            ctx.font = '12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('热工台 · ΔT ' + dt + ' K', boxX + 10, boxY + 22);
            if (Qshown == null) {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e4e0';
              if (playMode === 'challenge') {
                ctx.fillText('穿墙热流 待测 · 急单 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W', boxX + 10, boxY + 42);
              } else {
                ctx.fillText('穿墙热流 待测 · 点测试后显示', boxX + 10, boxY + 42);
              }
            } else if (playMode === 'challenge') {
              ctx.fillStyle = (Qshown >= TARGET_Q && Qshown <= TARGET_Q_HI) ? OK : (Qshown > TARGET_Q_HI ? GLOW : ACCENT);
              ctx.fillText('穿墙热流 ' + Qshown.toFixed(0) + ' W / 急单 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI, boxX + 10, boxY + 42);
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = HI;
              ctx.fillText('穿墙热流 ' + Qshown.toFixed(0) + ' W · 本次测量', boxX + 10, boxY + 42);
            }

            if (eventAnim && surge > 0.02) {
                const waveX = rodX0 + rodLen * (0.22 + surge * 0.18);
                const waveW = rodLen * (0.35 + surge * 0.45);
                const waveH = rodH * (2.2 + surge * 1.8);
                let haloC0, haloC1, strokeC;
                if (band === 'ok') {
                    haloC0 = 'rgba(111,174,143,' + (0.22 + bandFlash * 0.35 + surge * 0.25) + ')';
                    haloC1 = 'rgba(111,174,143,0)';
                    strokeC = OK;
                } else if (band === 'high') {
                    haloC0 = 'rgba(255,80,40,' + (0.35 + bandFlash * 0.45 + surge * 0.3) + ')';
                    haloC1 = 'rgba(255,80,40,0)';
                    strokeC = GLOW;
                } else {
                    haloC0 = 'rgba(255,96,64,' + (0.28 + surge * 0.35) + ')';
                    haloC1 = 'rgba(255,96,64,0)';
                    strokeC = ACCENT;
                }
                ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, 0.55 + surge * 0.45);
                const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(waveX, rodY, 8, waveX, rodY, waveW * 0.65);
                halo.addColorStop(0, haloC0);
                halo.addColorStop(1, haloC1);
                ctx.fillStyle = halo;
                ctx.fillRect(rodX0 - 20, rodY - waveH, rodLen + 40, waveH * 2);
                ctx.strokeStyle = strokeC;
                ctx.lineWidth = 3 + surge * 5 + (band === 'high' ? bandFlash * 4 : 0);
                ctx.shadowColor = strokeC;
                ctx.shadowBlur = 12 + surge * 20 + (band === 'high' ? bandFlash * 18 : 0);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(rodX0 - 10, rodY);
                ctx.lineTo(rodX1 + 10, rodY);
                ctx.stroke();
                if (band === 'high' && (eventAnim.phase === 'peak' || eventAnim.phase === 'settle')) {
                    const ripple = 8 + bandFlash * 16 + surge * 12;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,60,40,' + (0.35 + bandFlash * 0.5) + ')';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(rodX0 + rodLen * 0.42, rodY, ripple, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(rodX0 + rodLen * 0.58, rodY, ripple * 0.72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            }
        }

        function fireTest() {
            if (eventAnim) return;
            const k = parseFloat(kSlider.value);
            const dt = parseFloat(dtSlider.value);
            const Q = computeHeatRate(k, dt);
            const band = computeBand(Q);
            measuredQ = Q;
            heatDisplay.textContent = Q.toFixed(2);
            startEventAnim(k, dt, Q, parseFloat(aSlider.value), band);
            const controls = {
                's-thermal-conductivity': k.toString(),
                's-temperature-diff': dt.toString(),
                's-area': aSlider.value
            };
            if (playMode === 'explore') {
                feedback.innerHTML = '本次测量 ' + Q.toFixed(0) + ' W · 继续对比导热与温差';
                winArea.innerHTML = '';
                if (window.__emit) window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: false, hintKey: 'explore_observe' });
                return;
            }
            const winOk = Q >= TARGET_Q && Q <= TARGET_Q_HI;
            const tooHot = Q > TARGET_Q_HI;
            if (winOk) {
                feedback.innerHTML = '急单完成：热流落在安全带 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W。';
                if (!challengeWon) {
                  challengeWon = true;
                  if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                    window.__craftShowWin('急单安全带本局锁定。热流随导热与温差增大；太小供暖不足，太大则炉墙过热。');
                  }
                }
                winArea.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">🏆 过关！</span>';
            } else if (tooHot) {
                feedback.innerHTML = '<strong>炉墙过热</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">当前 ' + Q.toFixed(0) + ' W · 上限 ' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W</span>';
                winArea.innerHTML = '<span class="fail-badge" style="color:#fb7185;">未过关·过热</span>';
            } else {
                feedback.innerHTML = '<strong>供暖不足</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">当前 ' + Q.toFixed(0) + ' W · 下限 ' + TARGET_Q + ' W</span>';
                winArea.innerHTML = '<span class="fail-badge" style="color:#fda4af;">未过关·不足</span>';
            }
            if (window.__emit) {
                window.__emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: winOk, hintKey: winOk ? 'win_ok' : (tooHot ? 'retry_overheat' : 'retry_low_heat') });
                if (winOk) window.__emit('win', { winOk: true });
            }
        }

        function resetSim() {
            eventAnim = null;
            kSlider.value = '25';
            dtSlider.value = '20';
            aSlider.value = '0.05';
            measuredQ = null;
            updateReadings();
            if (playMode === 'challenge' && lockedQ != null) {
              feedback.innerHTML = '已重置滑条 · 急单安全带仍锁定 ' + TARGET_Q + '–' + TARGET_Q_HI + ' W · 点测试查看热流';
            } else {
              feedback.innerHTML = '已重置。调参后点「测试热流」再看瓦数。';
            }
            winArea.innerHTML = '';
        }

        testBtn.addEventListener('click', fireTest);
        resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetSim);
        [kSlider, dtSlider, aSlider].forEach(function(el) {
            el.addEventListener('input', function() {
                if (eventAnim) return;
                measuredQ = null;
                updateReadings();
                feedback.innerHTML = '调节中… 点击「测试热流」查看结果。';
                winArea.innerHTML = '';
            });
        });

        function tick(ts) {
            const dt = rafLastTs ? Math.min(0.05, (ts - rafLastTs) / 1000) : 0.016;
            rafLastTs = ts;
            if (!eventAnim) ambientT += dt;
            animT += dt;
            stepEventAnim(dt);
            updateReadings();
            requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', updateReadings);
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
            if (st) new ResizeObserver(updateReadings).observe(st);
        }
        refreshHeatGoals();
        feedback.innerHTML = '暴风雪夜里炉膛已偏热，穿墙热流仍不足。调节后点击「测试热流」。';
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })();
    </script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__heatApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__heatApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>


<script>
/* === craft-gold-runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__craftGold) return; window.__craftGold = true;
  var intro = document.getElementById('craft-intro');
  var win = document.getElementById('craft-win');
  var btn = document.getElementById('craftIntroBtn');
  var wbtn = document.getElementById('craftWinBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(intro) intro.hidden = true; });
  function replayLevel(){
    if (typeof window.__craftReplay === 'function') {
      try { window.__craftReplay(); return; } catch (e) {}
    }
    var rbtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset')
      || document.querySelector('#btnReset, button.btn-reset, [data-action="reset"]');
    if (rbtn) { try { rbtn.click(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  if (wbtn) wbtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    window.__craftWinDismissed = true;
    if (win) win.hidden = true;
    replayLevel();
  });

  // gauge into hud
  var hud = document.getElementById('essence-hud') || document.getElementById('dual-mode-hud') || document.getElementById('hud');
  if (hud && !document.getElementById('craft-gauge')) {
    var g = document.createElement('div');
    g.id = 'craft-gauge';
    g.innerHTML = '<span>目标仪表</span><strong id="craftGaugeVal">待测</strong>';
    hud.appendChild(g);
  }
function showWin(extra){
    if (win) {
      window.__craftWinDismissed = false;
      win.hidden = false;
      var t = document.getElementById('craftWinText');
      if (t && extra) t.textContent = extra;
    }
  }
  window.__craftShowWin = showWin;

  // Hook common win paths
  var _emit = window.__emit;
  window.__emit = function(type, payload){
    if (typeof _emit === 'function') _emit(type, payload);
    if (type === 'win') showWin();
  };
  // Observe win banners
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){
    if (window.__craftWinDismissed) return;
    var el = document.querySelector('.win-banner,.win-badge,#winBanner,[data-win="1"]');
    if (el && el.offsetParent !== null) showWin();
  });
  obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','style','hidden']});

  // Live gauge from first range readout if possible
  function tick(){
    var val = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .value-badge, #essence-bench .value, .observe-box .state, .observe-value, #craftGaugeVal');
    var src = document.querySelector('.observe-box .state, .observe-value, #hud-dist, #g-T, .gauge .gval');
    var gval = document.getElementById('craftGaugeVal');
    if (gval && src && src !== gval) gval.textContent = (src.textContent || '').trim() || '观测中';
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>

/* === dual-mode-shell (auto) === */
#dual-mode-hud {
  position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; z-index:8;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;
  gap:8px; pointer-events:none;
}
#dual-mode-hud .dual-chip {
  pointer-events:auto; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;
}
#dual-mode-hud #modeLabel { font-weight:700; color:#2563eb; }
#dual-mode-hud #timerDisplay { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600; color:#334155; }
#challengeStats {
  pointer-events:auto; display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border:1px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.45);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); color:#1e293b; font-size:13px;
}
#challengeStats.is-visible { display:inline-flex; }
#attemptsDisplay { font-weight:700; color:#dc2626; font-size:16px; }
#essence-bench-hd, .dual-bench-hd {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0; background:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
}
#essence-bench-hd h1, .dual-bench-hd h1 {
  margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#1e293b; line-height:1.3;
}
#modeSelect {
  border:1px solid #93c5fd; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px;
  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#1d4ed8; background:#eff6ff; cursor:pointer;
}
#essence-bench.dual-mode-ready { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
button.dual-disabled, .dual-disabled { opacity:0.45; pointer-events:none; cursor:not-allowed; }

/* Observe-box states: pending / measured / hit(ok) / miss */
#essence-bench .observe-box,
.observe-box,#observePanel{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 32%,transparent)!important;
  border-left:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-muted) 70%,var(--craft-accent))!important;
  border-radius:8px!important;
  color:var(--craft-text)!important;
  padding:12px 14px!important;
}
.observe-box.is-pending,.observe-box.pending,
.observe-box[data-state="pending"]{
  border-left-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-muted) 80%,transparent)!important;
  opacity:.92;
}
.observe-box.is-measured,.observe-box.measured,
.observe-box[data-state="measured"]{
  border-left-color:var(--craft-accent)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 18%,transparent);
}
.observe-box.is-hit,.observe-box.hit,.observe-box.ok,.observe-box.win,
.observe-box[data-state="hit"],.observe-box[data-state="ok"]{
  border-left-color:var(--scene-ok,#6fae8f)!important;
  background:rgba(34,197,94,.14)!important;
  border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.35)!important;
}
.observe-box.is-miss,.observe-box.miss,.observe-box.fail,
.observe-box[data-state="miss"],.observe-box[data-state="fail"]{
  border-left-color:#f87171!important;
  background:rgba(248,113,113,.14)!important;
  border-color:rgba(248,113,113,.35)!important;
}
.observe-box .label,.observe-box .state,.observe-box .val,.observe-box .reading{
  color:inherit;
}
.observe-box .state,.observe-box .reading,.observe-box .val{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);
  font-weight:700;
}

#btnLaunch,#btn-test,#btn-fire,#btnFire,#btnTest,#fireBtn{

<script>
(function(){
  function emit(type, payload) {
    try {
      if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
        window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function snapControls() {
    var o = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
      var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
    });
    return o;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    emit('puzzle_open', {});
    // tuning 绑定 (range)
    document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
        emit('tuning', { control: el.id || 'slider', value: el.value });
      });
    });
    // irrelevant touch
    var i1 = document.getElementById('I1');
    if (i1) {
      i1.addEventListener('change', function() {
        emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: i1.value });
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function() {
  // ----- 物理常量 & DOM 引用 -----
  const MASS = 0.5; // kg (固定)
  const canvas = document.getElementById('simCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 640, H = 320;
  let angle = 0;
  let lastTs = null;
  /** 测试后的舞台反馈：fly=切线飞出，drop=偏慢掉转，ok=安全带内巡航 */
  let rideAnim = null;

  function syncCanvasSize() {
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
    var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || canvas.clientWidth || 640);
    var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || canvas.clientHeight || 320);
    var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
    var bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
    if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) {
      canvas.width = bw;
      canvas.height = bh;
    }
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    W = cssW;
    H = cssH;
  }

  const sRadius = document.getElementById('s-radius');
  const sOmega = document.getElementById('s-omega');
  const sTilt = document.getElementById('s-base-tilt');
  const radiusDisplay = document.getElementById('radiusDisplay');
  const omegaDisplay = document.getElementById('omegaDisplay');
  const tiltDisplay = document.getElementById('tiltDisplay');
  const vDisplay = document.getElementById('vDisplay');
  const fDisplay = document.getElementById('fDisplay');
  const hintMsg = document.getElementById('hintMessage');
  const winMsg = document.getElementById('winMessage');
  const btnFire = document.getElementById('btn-fire');

  let V_TARGET = 2.5;
  let V_HI = 4.0;
  let F_TARGET = 3.0;
  let F_HI = 5.5;
  let playMode = 'explore';
  let exploreTests = 0;
  let exploreParamKeys = new Set();
  let exploreWon = false;
  let challengeWon = false;
  /** 仅测试后揭示 v、F */
  let measured = false;

  const MODE_GOALS = {
    explore: {
      hud: '试转：对比偏慢、稳转与偏快',
      side: '调 r、ω，看线速度与向心力怎么变。'
    },
    challenge: {
      hud: '限次把 v、F 调进本局安全带',
      side: '限次把 v、F 调进本局安全带（过慢/过快都不换阈值）。'
    }
  };

  function refreshGoalUI() {
    const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
    const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
    if (playMode === 'challenge') {
      if (mission) mission.textContent = '安全带：v ' + V_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + V_HI.toFixed(1) + ' 且 F ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + F_HI.toFixed(1) + ' · 本局固定';
      if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛巡检：把飞椅调进 v ' + V_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + V_HI.toFixed(1) + ' m/s 且 F ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + F_HI.toFixed(1) + ' N。过慢掉转、过快飞出都不换题。';
    } else {
      const g = MODE_GOALS.explore;
      if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
      if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
    }
  }

  /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次阈值（含上下界，避免拉满稳赢） */
  function lockChallengeTargets(reasonHint) {
    const rSol = 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.1;
    const wSol = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
    let nextV = Math.round(rSol * wSol * 0.82 * 10) / 10;
    let nextF = Math.round(MASS * wSol * wSol * rSol * 0.82 * 10) / 10;
    V_TARGET = Math.max(1.2, Math.min(5.0, nextV));
    F_TARGET = Math.max(1.2, Math.min(10.0, nextF));
    // 上界落在可探究中间带：最大滑条仍可冲出带外
    // 竞赛安全带更窄于探究对照带 (v 2.5–4.0 / F 3.0–5.5)，同参未必两边同结论
    // 安全带略放宽：仍须同时落入 v/F 带，避免「拉满即过」
    V_HI = Math.min(9.5, Math.round((V_TARGET * 1.42 + 0.45) * 10) / 10);
    F_HI = Math.min(22, Math.round((F_TARGET * 1.42 + 0.55) * 10) / 10);
    if (V_HI <= V_TARGET + 0.35) V_HI = Math.min(9.5, V_TARGET + 0.95);
    if (F_HI <= F_TARGET + 0.35) F_HI = Math.min(22, F_TARGET + 1.1);
    // 开局故意偏低，形成探究张力
    measured = false;
    sRadius.value = '0.5';
    sOmega.value = '1.0';
    updateSliders();
    refreshGoalUI();
    if (reasonHint) hintMsg.textContent = reasonHint + ' → 安全带锁定 v ' + V_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + V_HI.toFixed(1) + ' · F ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + F_HI.toFixed(1) + '（本局不变）· 点测试读数';
  }

  window.__circApplyMode = function(mode) {
    playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    exploreWon = false;
    challengeWon = false;
    measured = false;
    rideAnim = null;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = false;
    exploreTests = 0;
    exploreParamKeys = new Set();
    winMsg.innerHTML = '';
    if (playMode === 'challenge') {
      lockChallengeTargets('巡检单已下发');
    } else {
      V_TARGET = 2.5;
      V_HI = 4.0;
      F_TARGET = 3.0;
      F_HI = 5.5;
      sRadius.value = '0.8';
      sOmega.value = '2.0';
      updateSliders();
      refreshGoalUI();
      hintMsg.textContent = '读数待测 · 调 r、ω 后点测试';
    }
  };

  function computePhysics(r, omega) {
    const v = omega * r;
    const F = MASS * omega * omega * r;
    return { v, F };
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, rr) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + rr, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, rr);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, rr);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawScene(r, omega, tiltDeg) {
    syncCanvasSize();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const { F } = computePhysics(r, omega);
    const fNorm = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (F - F_TARGET) / Math.max(0.01, F_HI - F_TARGET)));
    const wNorm = Math.min(1, omega / 12);
    const danger = F > F_HI * 0.88 || omega > 9;
    const tilt = Math.max(0, Math.min(15, Number(tiltDeg) || 0));
    const tiltRad = (tilt * Math.PI) / 180;

    // 暖夜炭黑 + 琥珀投光（转盘工位）
    const SC = { ink: '#12100c', mid: '#2e2618', hi: '#f0c870', glow: '#ff8a30', metal: '#7a8490', accent: '#e0a040', ok: '#7dba8c' };
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1510');
    bg.addColorStop(0.35, SC.ink);
    bg.addColorStop(0.7, '#181410');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#0e0c08');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const flood = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.22, H * 0.08, 8, W * 0.38, H * 0.55, Math.max(W, H) * 0.72);
    flood.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,138,48,' + (0.14 + wNorm * 0.14) + ')');
    flood.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(224,160,64,0.10)');
    flood.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(18,16,12,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = flood;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const flood2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.82, H * 0.05, 4, W * 0.72, H * 0.4, W * 0.35);
    flood2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,200,112,0.08)');
    flood2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(18,16,12,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = flood2;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // 暖尘微粒 + 工位挂灯
    for (var i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,200,112,' + (0.08 + (i % 5) * 0.04) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc((i * 97) % W, 18 + (i * 37) % 80, 1 + (i % 3) * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (var L = 0; L < 5; L++) {
      var lx = 70 + L * (W / 5.2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lx, 8);
      ctx.lineTo(lx, 32);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = L % 2 ? SC.accent : SC.hi;
      roundRect(lx - 9, 32, 18, 22, 6);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,138,48,0.35)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      var lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, 48, 1, lx, 52, 14);
      lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,138,48,' + (0.15 + wNorm * 0.18) + ')');
      lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,138,48,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = lg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(lx, 52, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // 糖画摊剪影（叙事锚点）
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1410';
    ctx.fillRect(18, H - 110, 72, 74);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c06020';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12, H - 110);
    ctx.lineTo(54, H - 138);
    ctx.lineTo(96, H - 110);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('糖画摊', 30, H - 118);

    // 工位地坪
    const floor = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 36, 0, H);
    floor.addColorStop(0, '#3a3228');
    floor.addColorStop(1, SC.ink);
    ctx.fillStyle = floor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 36, W, 36);
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 36, W, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(224,160,64,0.18)';
    for (var g = 0; g < 10; g++) ctx.fillRect(16 + g * 70, H - 20, 28, 3);

    // 飞椅中枢：转盘直径 ≥50% min(W,H)
    const cx = Math.max(200, Math.min(W * 0.48, W - 180));
    const cy = Math.max(138, Math.min(H * 0.48, H - 100));
    const targetDia = Math.min(W, H) * 0.52;
    const maxR = Math.min(cx - 36, cy - 56, W - cx - 70, H - cy - 48, targetDia * 0.55);
    const scale = Math.max(maxR / 2.05, Math.min(140, targetDia / 3.6));

    // 加大钢制底座 + 立柱（底座倾角 φ 仅改观感：倾斜椭圆与楔块，不改 v/F 物理）
    const baseRx = Math.max(110, maxR * 0.55), baseRy = 28;
    const baseCy = H - 38;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, baseCy);
    ctx.rotate(-tiltRad * 0.55);
    const baseGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-baseRx, -26, baseRx, 20);
    baseGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a5058');
    baseGrad.addColorStop(0.5, SC.metal);
    baseGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a626a');
    ctx.fillStyle = baseGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, baseRx, baseRy * (1 - tilt * 0.012), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(224,160,64,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    for (var bolt = 0; bolt < 8; bolt++) {
      var baBolt = (bolt / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6268';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(Math.cos(baBolt) * (baseRx - 14), Math.sin(baBolt) * (baseRy - 6), 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    if (tilt > 0.2) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(224,160,64,' + (0.18 + tilt * 0.02) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-baseRx * 0.72, baseRy * 0.35);
      ctx.lineTo(-baseRx * 0.35, baseRy * 0.9 + tilt * 0.9);
      ctx.lineTo(baseRx * 0.2, baseRy * 0.55);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
      ctx.font = 'bold 11px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('φ ' + tilt.toFixed(0) + '°', -22, baseRy + 14);
    }
    ctx.restore();
    const colGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - 22, cy, cx + 22, cy);
    colGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a5058');
    colGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#9aa2a8');
    colGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4a5058');
    ctx.fillStyle = colGrad;
    roundRect(cx - 20, cy - 10, 40, H - 46 - (cy - 10), 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.65)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    // 转台顶盖
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4048';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy - 10, 34, Math.PI, 0);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy - 10, 34, Math.PI, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
    for (var bulb = 0; bulb < 8; bulb++) {
      var ba = -Math.PI + (bulb / 7) * Math.PI;
      var blx = cx + Math.cos(ba) * 28;
      var bly = cy - 10 + Math.sin(ba) * 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = bulb % 2 ? SC.hi : SC.glow;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(blx, bly, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (bulb % 2 === 0) {
        var bulbGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(blx, bly, 0, blx, bly, 12);
        bulbGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,138,48,0.4)');
        bulbGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,138,48,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = bulbGlow;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(blx, bly, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }


    const drawR = rideAnim ? rideAnim.r0 : r;
    const drawOmega = rideAnim ? rideAnim.omega0 : omega;
    const radiusPx = Math.max(18, drawR * scale);
    const aNow = rideAnim ? rideAnim.angle0 : angle;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radiusPx, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'fly'
      ? 'rgba(255,138,48,0.55)'
      : 'rgba(224,160,64,0.45)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    let bx, by, armConnected = true;
    if (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'fly') {
      bx = rideAnim.x;
      by = rideAnim.y;
      armConnected = false;
      // 断臂残端：停在脱离瞬间的圆周点
      const hx = cx + radiusPx * Math.cos(rideAnim.angle0);
      const hy = cy + radiusPx * Math.sin(rideAnim.angle0);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(hx, hy);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 5]);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      // 飞出轨迹
      if (rideAnim.trail && rideAnim.trail.length > 1) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(rideAnim.trail[0].x, rideAnim.trail[0].y);
        for (var ti = 1; ti < rideAnim.trail.length; ti++) {
          ctx.lineTo(rideAnim.trail[ti].x, rideAnim.trail[ti].y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,138,48,0.78)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else if (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'drop') {
      bx = rideAnim.x;
      by = rideAnim.y;
      armConnected = rideAnim.t < rideAnim.snapT;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
      ctx.strokeStyle = armConnected ? '#d08060' : 'rgba(208,128,96,0.28)';
      ctx.lineWidth = armConnected ? 2.5 : 1.5;
      if (!armConnected) ctx.setLineDash([2, 4]);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    } else {
      bx = cx + radiusPx * Math.cos(aNow);
      by = cy + radiusPx * Math.sin(aNow);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
      const cableColor = danger
        ? ('rgba(224,80,60,' + (0.65 + fNorm * 0.35) + ')')
        : (fNorm > 0.55 ? ('rgba(224,160,64,' + (0.55 + fNorm * 0.35) + ')') : SC.ok);
      ctx.strokeStyle = rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'ok' ? SC.ok : cableColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'ok' ? 2.5 : (2 + fNorm * 1.5);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'ok') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, radiusPx + 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(125,186,140,' + (0.35 + 0.35 * Math.sin(rideAnim.t * 10)) + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // 座舱（加大可见）
    ctx.fillStyle = rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'fly' ? '#e06040'
      : (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'drop' ? '#c08060' : SC.accent);
    roundRect(bx - 20, by - 12, 40, 28, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'fly' ? '#8a3020' : '#a07020';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,200,0.35)';
    roundRect(bx - 12, by - 6, 14, 10, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.ink;
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('座', bx + 4, by + 8);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // 飞出火花 / 掉转尘土
    if (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'fly') {
      for (var sp = 0; sp < 6; sp++) {
        var sf = (rideAnim.t * 18 + sp * 1.7) % 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,138,48,' + (0.85 - sf * 0.8) + ')';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bx - rideAnim.vx * sf * 0.04, by - rideAnim.vy * sf * 0.04, 2.2 - sf, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,140,0.92)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('超速飞出', Math.min(W - 88, Math.max(12, bx + 16)), Math.max(70, by - 14));
    } else if (rideAnim && rideAnim.kind === 'drop') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,140,0.9)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('偏慢掉转', Math.min(W - 88, Math.max(12, bx + 16)), Math.max(70, by - 14));
    }

    // 轴心 hub
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9aa0a8';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SC.accent;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e0d0';
    ctx.fill();

    roundRect(16, H - 78, 168, 52, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,16,12,0.88)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(224,160,64,0.45)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
    ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace,Consolas,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('r = ' + drawR.toFixed(1) + ' m', 28, H - 56);
    ctx.fillText('ω = ' + drawOmega.toFixed(1) + ' rad/s', 28, H - 36);
  }

  function startRideAnim(kind, r, omega, onDone) {
    const cx = Math.max(200, Math.min(W * 0.48, W - 180));
    const cy = Math.max(138, Math.min(H * 0.48, H - 100));
    const targetDia = Math.min(W, H) * 0.52;
    const maxR = Math.min(cx - 36, cy - 56, W - cx - 70, H - cy - 48, targetDia * 0.55);
    const scale = Math.max(maxR / 2.05, Math.min(140, targetDia / 3.6));
    const radiusPx = Math.max(18, r * scale);
    const a0 = angle;
    const x0 = cx + radiusPx * Math.cos(a0);
    const y0 = cy + radiusPx * Math.sin(a0);
    // 切线方向（与 angle += omega*dt 一致：逆时针）
    const tx = -Math.sin(a0);
    const ty = Math.cos(a0);
    const speed = Math.max(40, Math.min(420, omega * radiusPx * 1.15));
    if (kind === 'fly') {
      rideAnim = {
        kind: 'fly', t: 0, dur: 1.35, onDone: onDone || null,
        r0: r, omega0: omega, angle0: a0, cx: cx, cy: cy, scale: scale,
        x: x0, y: y0,
        vx: tx * speed * 1.35 + Math.cos(a0) * speed * 0.25,
        vy: ty * speed * 1.35 + Math.sin(a0) * speed * 0.25,
        trail: [{ x: x0, y: y0 }]
      };
    } else if (kind === 'drop') {
      rideAnim = {
        kind: 'drop', t: 0, dur: 1.45, snapT: 0.55, onDone: onDone || null,
        r0: r, omega0: omega, angle0: a0, cx: cx, cy: cy, scale: scale,
        x: x0, y: y0, vx: tx * speed * 0.15, vy: 0, spin: a0
      };
    } else {
      // 探究模式短 ride（0.55–0.85s），竞赛完整 1.1s
      var okDur = (typeof playMode !== 'undefined' && playMode === 'explore')
        ? (0.55 + Math.min(0.3, Math.abs(omega) * 0.08))
        : 1.1;
      rideAnim = {
        kind: 'ok', t: 0, dur: okDur, onDone: onDone || null,
        r0: r, omega0: omega, angle0: a0, cx: cx, cy: cy, scale: scale
      };
    }
  }

  function stepRideAnim(dt) {
    if (!rideAnim) return;
    rideAnim.t += dt;
    if (rideAnim.kind === 'fly') {
      rideAnim.vy += 520 * dt;
      rideAnim.vx *= (1 - 0.35 * dt);
      rideAnim.x += rideAnim.vx * dt;
      rideAnim.y += rideAnim.vy * dt;
      rideAnim.trail.push({ x: rideAnim.x, y: rideAnim.y });
      if (rideAnim.trail.length > 28) rideAnim.trail.shift();
      if (rideAnim.y > H - 48) {
        rideAnim.y = H - 48;
        rideAnim.vy *= -0.18;
        rideAnim.vx *= 0.7;
      }
    } else if (rideAnim.kind === 'drop') {
      const radiusPx = Math.max(18, rideAnim.r0 * rideAnim.scale);
      if (rideAnim.t < rideAnim.snapT) {
        // 动力不足：向内塌缩并下沉，仍连着臂
        const u = rideAnim.t / rideAnim.snapT;
        const shrink = 1 - 0.55 * u * u;
        rideAnim.spin += rideAnim.omega0 * dt * (1 - 0.7 * u);
        rideAnim.x = rideAnim.cx + radiusPx * shrink * Math.cos(rideAnim.spin);
        rideAnim.y = rideAnim.cy + radiusPx * shrink * Math.sin(rideAnim.spin) + 18 * u * u;
      } else {
        // 脱臂坠落
        rideAnim.vy += 780 * dt;
        rideAnim.vx *= (1 - 0.8 * dt);
        rideAnim.x += rideAnim.vx * dt;
        rideAnim.y += rideAnim.vy * dt;
        if (rideAnim.y > H - 48) {
          rideAnim.y = H - 48;
          rideAnim.vy = 0;
          rideAnim.vx *= 0.5;
        }
      }
    } else if (rideAnim.kind === 'ok') {
      angle += rideAnim.omega0 * dt;
      rideAnim.angle0 = angle;
    }
    if (rideAnim.t >= rideAnim.dur) {
      var done = rideAnim.onDone;
      rideAnim = null;
      if (typeof done === 'function') done();
    }
  }

  function updateObserve(r, omega, reveal) {
    const { v, F } = computePhysics(r, omega);
    if (reveal || measured) {
      vDisplay.textContent = v.toFixed(2);
      fDisplay.textContent = F.toFixed(2);
    } else {
      vDisplay.textContent = '—';
      fDisplay.textContent = '—';
    }
    return { v, F };
  }

  function checkWin(v, F) {
    const vLow = v < V_TARGET;
    const vHigh = v > V_HI;
    const fLow = F < F_TARGET;
    const fHigh = F > F_HI;
    const vOk = !vLow && !vHigh;
    const fOk = !fLow && !fHigh;
    const winOk = vOk && fOk;
    let hintKey = '';
    let failKind = '';
    if (winOk) hintKey = 'win';
    else if (vHigh || fHigh) {
      hintKey = 'too_fast';
      failKind = 'fly';
    } else if (vLow || fLow) {
      hintKey = (vLow && fLow) ? 'both_low' : (vLow ? 'v_low' : 'f_low');
      failKind = 'slow';
    }
    return { winOk, hintKey, vOk, fOk, vLow, vHigh, fLow, fHigh, failKind };
  }

  function fireTest() {
    if (rideAnim) return; // 飞出/掉转播完再测，避免叠动画
    const r = parseFloat(sRadius.value);
    const omega = parseFloat(sOmega.value);
    measured = true;
    const { v, F } = updateObserve(r, omega, true);
    const { winOk, hintKey, vOk, fOk, vLow, vHigh, fLow, fHigh, failKind } = checkWin(v, F);
    var controls = { 's-radius': r, 's-omega': omega };
    const emit = window.__emit || function(){};
    const animKind = winOk ? 'ok' : (failKind === 'fly' ? 'fly' : (failKind === 'slow' ? 'drop' : 'ok'));

    if (playMode === 'challenge') {
      if (winOk) {
        if (!challengeWon) {
          challengeWon = true;
          hintMsg.textContent = '巡检通过！v、F 均落在安全带内。';
          winMsg.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">巡检过关</span>';
          emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: 'circ_challenge' });
          emit('win', { winOk: true });
          if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
            window.__craftShowWin('你在本局锁定的安全带内调对了半径与角速度：过慢不够、过快会飞出。');
          }
        }
        startRideAnim('ok', r, omega, null);
      } else {
        let msg = failKind === 'fly' ? '超速飞出：' : '动力不足：';
        if (vLow) msg += 'v偏低 ';
        if (vHigh) msg += 'v过高 ';
        if (fLow) msg += 'F偏低 ';
        if (fHigh) msg += 'F过高 ';
        winMsg.innerHTML = failKind === 'fly'
          ? '<span class="fail-badge" style="color:#fb7185;">未过关·超速飞出</span>'
          : '<span class="fail-badge" style="color:#fca5a5;">未过关·偏慢掉转</span>';
        emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: false, hintKey: hintKey });
        hintMsg.innerHTML = '<strong>' + msg.trim() + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">舞台：' + (failKind === 'fly' ? '切线飞出' : '向内掉转') + ' · 安全带仍锁</span>';
        // 先播飞出/掉转，结束后再重置偏低初值（FixedChallenge 不重抽阈值）
        startRideAnim(animKind, r, omega, function() {
          measured = false;
          sRadius.value = '0.5';
          sOmega.value = '1.0';
          updateSliders();
          refreshGoalUI();
          hintMsg.innerHTML = '<strong>' + msg.trim() + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.82em;opacity:.92">安全带 v ' + V_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + V_HI.toFixed(1) + ' · F ' + F_TARGET.toFixed(1) + '–' + F_HI.toFixed(1) + '</span>';
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    // 探究：换参对比；同步播偏慢/偏快舞台形态，便于目视区分
    exploreTests += 1;
    exploreParamKeys.add(r.toFixed(1) + '|' + omega.toFixed(1));
    let msg = '本次 v=' + v.toFixed(2) + ' · F=' + F.toFixed(2);
    if (failKind === 'fly') msg += ' · 偏快：座舱切线飞出（示意）';
    else if (failKind === 'slow') msg += ' · 偏慢：座舱向内掉转（示意）';
    else msg += ' · 落在参考安全带内';
    msg += '。换组参数再对比。';
    hintMsg.textContent = msg;
    winMsg.innerHTML = '';
    startRideAnim(animKind, r, omega, null);
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: false, hintKey: 'explore_sample' });
    if (!exploreWon && exploreTests >= 3 && exploreParamKeys.size >= 2) {
      exploreWon = true;
      winMsg.innerHTML = '<span class="win-badge">探究完成</span>';
      hintMsg.textContent = '已对比多组读数 · 可切换竞赛接安全巡检（安全带本局固定）';
      emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: 'circ_explore' });
      emit('win', { winOk: true });
      if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
        window.__craftShowWin('你通过对比不同 r、ω 下的读数，归纳了线速度与向心力的关系。');
      }
    }
  }

  function updateSliders() {
    const r = parseFloat(sRadius.value);
    const omega = parseFloat(sOmega.value);
    const tilt = sTilt ? parseFloat(sTilt.value) : 0;
    radiusDisplay.textContent = r.toFixed(1) + ' m';
    omegaDisplay.textContent = omega.toFixed(1) + ' rad/s';
    if (tiltDisplay) tiltDisplay.textContent = tilt.toFixed(0) + '°';
    updateObserve(r, omega, false);
  }

  sRadius.addEventListener('input', function() {
    measured = false;
    updateSliders();
    hintMsg.textContent = '调节中… 点「测试 / 发射」查看 v、F';
    winMsg.innerHTML = '';
  });
  sOmega.addEventListener('input', function() {
    measured = false;
    updateSliders();
    hintMsg.textContent = '调节中… 点「测试 / 发射」查看 v、F';
    winMsg.innerHTML = '';
  });
  if (sTilt) sTilt.addEventListener('input', function() {
    measured = false;
    updateSliders();
    hintMsg.textContent = '调节中… 点「测试 / 发射」查看 v、F';
    winMsg.innerHTML = '';
  });
  btnFire.addEventListener('click', fireTest);

  function loop(ts) {
    if (lastTs == null) lastTs = ts;
    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - lastTs) / 1000);
    lastTs = ts;
    const r = parseFloat(sRadius.value);
    const omega = parseFloat(sOmega.value);
    if (rideAnim) {
      stepRideAnim(dt);
    } else {
      // 视觉角速度严格跟随滑条 ω（rad/s）
      angle += omega * dt;
    }
    updateObserve(r, omega, false);
    const tiltNow = sTilt ? parseFloat(sTilt.value) : 0;
    drawScene(r, omega, tiltNow);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  updateSliders();
  refreshGoalUI();
  hintMsg.textContent = '读数未达巡检线 · 调 r、ω 后点测试';
  winMsg.innerHTML = '';
  window.__circRedraw = function() {
    updateSliders();
  };

})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__essenceStageResize) return;
  window.__essenceStageResize = true;
  function fit(){
    if (typeof window.__circRedraw === 'function') {
      window.__circRedraw();
      return;
    }
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    var cvs = stage && stage.querySelector('canvas');
    if (!stage || !cvs) return;
    var w = stage.clientWidth, h = stage.clientHeight;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2) return;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__circApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__circApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
