  top:10px!important;left:10px!important;right:auto!important;
  max-width:min(360px,calc(100% - 24px))!important;
}
#hud > .hud-chip,
#hud > .gauge,
#hud > .hud-chip.gauge{
  position:absolute!important;
  top:10px!important;right:12px!important;left:auto!important;
  align-items:flex-end!important;
  max-width:min(240px,calc(100% - 24px))!important;
  z-index:11!important;
}
#craft-gauge{display:none!important;}
#dual-mode-hud #goalMission{display:none!important;}

/* Slider track / thumb */
#essence-bench input[type=range],
.slider-group input[type=range],
.slider-row input[type=range],
#bench input[type=range],
#controls-area input[type=range],
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:100%;height:28px;margin:2px 0 8px;background:transparent;
  accent-color:var(--craft-accent);
}
#essence-bench input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
.slider-group input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
.slider-row input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
#bench input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:6px;border-radius:999px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-bg,#0c1218) 80%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-panel,#162028) 70%,#fff));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
#essence-bench input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.slider-group input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.slider-row input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
#bench input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb,
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:-6px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 55%,#fff),var(--craft-accent) 60%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 55%,#000));
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 40%,#000);
  box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  cursor:pointer;
}

/* Label + value badge */
#essence-bench label,
.slider-group label,
.slider-row label,
.slabel,
#bench label{
  color:var(--craft-muted)!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  font-weight:600!important;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}
#essence-bench .value-badge,
.slider-row .value-badge,
.slider-row .value,
.slider-group .value,
.value-badge,
.sval,
.value-tag,
#essence-bench .value{
  display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  min-width:52px;padding:2px 10px!important;border-radius:999px!important;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 35%,transparent)!important;
  color:var(--scene-hi,var(--craft-accent))!important;
  font-family:var(--font-mono)!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:600!important;
}

/* Observe-box states: pending / measured / hit(ok) / miss */
#essence-bench .observe-box,
.observe-box,#observePanel{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 32%,transparent)!important;
  border-left:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-muted) 70%,var(--craft-accent))!important;
  border-radius:8px!important;
  color:var(--craft-text)!important;
  padding:12px 14px!important;
}
.observe-box.is-pending,.observe-box.pending,
.observe-box[data-state="pending"]{
  border-left-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-muted) 80%,transparent)!important;
  opacity:.92;
}
.observe-box.is-measured,.observe-box.measured,
.observe-box[data-state="measured"]{
  border-left-color:var(--craft-accent)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--craft-accent) 18%,transparent);
}
.observe-box.is-hit,.observe-box.hit,.observe-box.ok,.observe-box.win,
.observe-box[data-state="hit"],.observe-box[data-state="ok"]{
  border-left-color:var(--scene-ok,#6fae8f)!important;
  background:rgba(34,197,94,.14)!important;
  border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.35)!important;
}
.observe-box.is-miss,.observe-box.miss,.observe-box.fail,
.observe-box[data-state="miss"],.observe-box[data-state="fail"]{
  border-left-color:#f87171!important;
  background:rgba(248,113,113,.14)!important;
  border-color:rgba(248,113,113,.35)!important;
}
.observe-box .label,.observe-box .state,.observe-box .val,.observe-box .reading{
  color:inherit;
}
.observe-box .state,.observe-box .reading,.observe-box .val{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);
  font-weight:700;
}

/* Primary action button */
#essence-bench .btn,button.btn,.pixel-btn,
#btnLaunch,#btn-test,#btn-fire,#btnFire,#btnTest,#fireBtn{
  padding:11px 16px!important;
  border-radius:10px!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
  transition:opacity .15s,filter .15s,transform .12s;
}
#essence-bench .btn:disabled,button.btn:disabled,.pixel-btn:disabled,
#btnLaunch:disabled,#btn-test:disabled,#btn-fire:disabled,#btnFire:disabled,#btnTest:disabled,#fireBtn:disabled,
button.dual-disabled,.dual-disabled,
button.is-playing,.btn.is-playing,.pixel-btn.is-playing{
  opacity:.45!important;
  cursor:not-allowed!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
  filter:grayscale(.15);
  transform:none!important;
}

/* De-emphasize confound / irrelevant zones */
.confound-note,
.irrelevant-area,
.srow-irrelevant,
.irrelevant-touch,
#essence-bench .confound-note,
#bench .confound-note,
#controls-area .confound-note{
  opacity:.7!important;
  font-size:.8rem!important;
  transform:scale(.98);
  transform-origin:left top;
  filter:saturate(.75);
}
.irrelevant-area button,
.irrelevant-touch{
  padding:3px 10px!important;
  font-size:.75rem!important;
  opacity:.75!important;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="craft-intro">
  <div class="craft-card">
    <h2>气垫导轨 · 碰撞</h2>
    <p>导轨上两滑块对撞——包件 2 能否进接货口？调质量与初速，看碰撞后包件 2 何时进区。</p>
    <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--craft-muted)">探究与竞赛目标不同；竞赛口位进入后固定，未投进只扣次数。</p>
    <button type="button" id="craftIntroBtn">开始探究</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="craft-win" hidden>
  <div class="craft-card">
    <h2>过关 · 你学到了什么</h2>
    <div class="formula" id="craftWinFormula">m1v1 + m2v2 = 守恒（一维）</div>
    <p id="craftWinText">对撞前后，你对照了两包件的质量、速度与是否进区，摸清了动量如何分配。</p>
    <button type="button" id="craftWinBtn">再玩一次</button>
  </div>
</div>


<div id="essence-app" class="essence-legacy-hide-outer">
  <div id="essence-stage">
    <div class="canvas-wrap">
        <canvas id="collisionCanvas" width="760" height="360"></canvas>
    </div>

    
    <div id="essence-hud">
      <div class="essence-title">气垫导轨台</div>
      <div class="essence-sub" id="goalMission">对撞几轮：对比进区与未进</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <aside id="essence-bench">
    <div class="essence-scroll">
    <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#7dd3fc;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:4px">当前目标</div>
    <p id="sideGoal" style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:rgba(226,232,240,.92)">调质量与初速，看包件 2 何时进接货口。</p>
      <!-- 调节变量 (4个滑条) -->
    <div class="control-panel">
        <div class="slider-group">
            <label>包件1质量 m₁ <span class="value-badge" id="mass1Val">1.0 kg</span></label>
            <input type="range" id="s-mass1" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.1" value="1.0">
        </div>
        <div class="slider-group">
            <label>包件2质量 m₂ <span class="value-badge" id="mass2Val">1.0 kg</span></label>
            <input type="range" id="s-mass2" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.1" value="1.0">
        </div>
        <div class="slider-group">
            <label>包件1初速 v₁ <span class="value-badge" id="vel1Val">2.0 m/s</span></label>
            <input type="range" id="s-vel1" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" value="2.0">
        </div>
        <div class="slider-group">
            <label>包件2初速 v₂ <span class="value-badge" id="vel2Val">0.0 m/s</span></label>
            <input type="range" id="s-vel2" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" value="0.0">
        </div>
        <div class="slider-group">
            <label>导轨温度 T <span class="value-badge" id="railTempVal">22 °C</span></label>
            <input type="range" id="s-rail-temp" min="5" max="60" step="1" value="22">
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 操作按钮 + 混淆变量说明 -->
    <!-- 观测区 (输出变量) -->
    <div class="observe-box" id="observePanel">
        <span class="observe-item"><strong>v₁'</strong> (包件1末速): <span id="ov1Display">—</span> m/s</span>
        <span class="observe-item"><strong>v₂'</strong> (包件2末速): <span id="ov2Display">—</span> m/s</span>
        <span class="observe-item"><strong>包件2进区?</strong> <span id="ov3Display">未检测</span></span>
        <div id="hintMessage" class="hint-msg">包件2尚未进区 · 调参后点发射</div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer">
        <span id="footerGoal">目标：试着让包件2进入接货口</span>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="essence-ft">
      <div class="action-row">
        <button class="btn" id="btn-fire">发射</button>
        <button class="btn btn-reset" id="btn-reset">重置</button>
        <span class="confound-note">碰撞过程很短 · 可先忽略外力冲量</span>
        <!-- 隐藏的 I1 占位 (仅用于埋点 irrelevant_touch 但不展示) -->
        <input type="hidden" id="I1" value="irrelevant">
    </div>
    </div>
  </aside>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
    // ----- 物理常量 & DOM 引用 -----
    const canvas = document.getElementById('collisionCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const DESIGN_W = 760, DESIGN_H = 360;
    let W = DESIGN_W, H = DESIGN_H;

    function syncCanvasSize() {
        var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage') || canvas.parentElement;
        var cssW = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientWidth) || canvas.clientWidth || DESIGN_W);
        var cssH = Math.max(2, (stage && stage.clientHeight) || canvas.clientHeight || DESIGN_H);
        var dpr = Math.min(2.5, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
        var bw = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
        var bh = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
        if (canvas.width !== bw || canvas.height !== bh) {
            canvas.width = bw;
            canvas.height = bh;
        }
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        W = cssW;
        H = cssH;
    }

    let layoutMom = null;
    let playMode = 'explore';
    let targetCenterFrac = 0.75;
    let targetWidthFrac = 0.18; // 探究宽接货口；竞赛锁定时收窄
    let exploreShots = 0;
    let sawIn = false;
    let sawMiss = false;
    let exploreWon = false;
    let challengeWon = false;

    const MODE_GOALS = {
      explore: {
        hud: '对撞几轮：对比进区与未进',
        side: '调质量与初速，看包件 2 何时进接货口。'
      },
      challenge: {
        hud: '限次把包件 2 送进本局接货口',
        side: '限次把包件 2 送进本局接货口（打偏不换口）。'
      }
    };

    function refreshGoalUI() {
      const mission = document.getElementById('goalMission');
      const side = document.getElementById('sideGoal');
      const foot = document.getElementById('footerGoal');
      if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        const pct = Math.round(targetCenterFrac * 100);
        if (mission) mission.textContent = '当前接货口：约轨道 ' + pct + '% 处 · 本局固定';
        if (side) side.textContent = '竞赛急单：限次把包件2送进约轨道 ' + pct + '% 处接货口（本局固定，打偏不换口）。';
        if (foot) foot.textContent = '急单：投进约 ' + pct + '% 处接货口（固定）';
      } else {
        const g = MODE_GOALS.explore;
        if (mission) mission.textContent = g.hud;
        if (side) side.textContent = g.side;
        if (foot) foot.textContent = '试投：观察末速与是否进区';
      }
    }

    /** FixedChallenge：仅进入竞赛时锁定一次接货口（更窄，目视可辨） */
    function lockChallengeBay(reasonHint) {
      targetCenterFrac = 0.62 + Math.random() * 0.22;
      targetWidthFrac = 0.07 + Math.random() * 0.025; // 明显窄于探究 0.18
      // 开局张力：默认参数往往投不进
      sVel1.value = '2.0';
      sMass1.value = '1.0';
      sMass2.value = '1.5';
      sVel2.value = '0.0';
      updateSliderLabels();
      resetSim(true);
      refreshGoalUI();
      if (reasonHint) hintMsg.textContent = reasonHint + ' → 接货口已锁定在约 ' + Math.round(targetCenterFrac * 100) + '% 处（本局不变）';
    }

    window.__momApplyMode = function(mode) {
      playMode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
      exploreWon = false;
      challengeWon = false;
      window.__legacyWinEmitted = false;
      exploreShots = 0;
      sawIn = false;
      sawMiss = false;
      if (playMode === 'challenge') {
        lockChallengeBay('急单已下发');
      } else {
        targetCenterFrac = 0.75;
        targetWidthFrac = 0.18;
        sMass1.value = '1.0';
        sMass2.value = '1.0';
        sVel1.value = '2.0';
        sVel2.value = '0.0';
        updateSliderLabels();
        resetSim(true);
        refreshGoalUI();
        hintMsg.textContent = '包件2尚未进区 · 调参后点发射';
      }
    };

    function layoutMetrics() {
        const GROUND_Y = Math.round(H * 0.78);
        const BALL_R = Math.max(14, Math.min(20, Math.round(H * 0.045)));
        const BALL1_INIT_X = Math.max(150, Math.round(W * 0.18));
        const BALL2_INIT_X = Math.max(BALL1_INIT_X + 120, Math.round(W * 0.36));
        const bayW = Math.round(W * targetWidthFrac);
        const bayC = Math.round(W * targetCenterFrac);
        const TARGET_LEFT = Math.max(BALL2_INIT_X + 80, bayC - Math.round(bayW / 2));
        const TARGET_RIGHT = Math.min(W - 40, TARGET_LEFT + bayW);
        const TARGET_Y_TOP = GROUND_Y - 70;
        const TARGET_Y_BOT = GROUND_Y + 8;
        const PX_PER_M = Math.max(28, Math.min(48, W / 18));
        layoutMom = { GROUND_Y, BALL_R, BALL1_INIT_X, BALL2_INIT_X, TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_RIGHT, TARGET_Y_TOP, TARGET_Y_BOT, PX_PER_M };
        return layoutMom;
    }

    const sMass1 = document.getElementById('s-mass1');
    const sMass2 = document.getElementById('s-mass2');
    const sVel1  = document.getElementById('s-vel1');
    const sVel2  = document.getElementById('s-vel2');
    const sRailTemp = document.getElementById('s-rail-temp');
    const mass1Val = document.getElementById('mass1Val');
    const mass2Val = document.getElementById('mass2Val');
    const vel1Val  = document.getElementById('vel1Val');
    const vel2Val  = document.getElementById('vel2Val');
    const railTempVal = document.getElementById('railTempVal');
    const btnFire  = document.getElementById('btn-fire');
    const btnReset = document.getElementById('btn-reset');
    const ov1Display = document.getElementById('ov1Display');
    const ov2Display = document.getElementById('ov2Display');
    const ov3Display = document.getElementById('ov3Display');
    const hintMsg    = document.getElementById('hintMessage');

    let m1 = 1.0, m2 = 1.0, v1 = 2.0, v2 = 0.0;
    let v1f = null, v2f = null;
    let ball1X = 120, ball2X = 280;
    let ball1Y = 300, ball2Y = 300;
    let hasFired = false;
    let winOk = false;
    let hintKey = 'initial';
    let animating = false;

    function computeCollision(m1, m2, v1, v2) {
        const sum = m1 + m2;
        if (sum === 0) return { v1f: 0, v2f: 0 };
        const v1f = ((m1 - m2) * v1 + 2 * m2 * v2) / sum;
        const v2f = ((m2 - m1) * v2 + 2 * m1 * v1) / sum;
        return { v1f, v2f };
    }

    function updateSliderLabels() {
        mass1Val.textContent = parseFloat(sMass1.value).toFixed(1) + ' kg';
        mass2Val.textContent = parseFloat(sMass2.value).toFixed(1) + ' kg';
        vel1Val.textContent  = parseFloat(sVel1.value).toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
        vel2Val.textContent  = parseFloat(sVel2.value).toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
        if (railTempVal && sRailTemp) railTempVal.textContent = parseFloat(sRailTemp.value).toFixed(0) + ' °C';
    }

    function readControls() {
        m1 = parseFloat(sMass1.value);
        m2 = parseFloat(sMass2.value);
        v1 = parseFloat(sVel1.value);
        v2 = parseFloat(sVel2.value);
    }

    function ballRadius(mass) {
        var L = layoutMom || layoutMetrics();
        return L.BALL_R * (0.75 + 0.08 * Math.min(10, mass));
    }

    function resetSim(keepControls = true) {
        if (keepControls) readControls();
        syncCanvasSize();
        var L = layoutMetrics();
        ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X;
        ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X;
        ball1Y = L.GROUND_Y - ballRadius(m1);
        ball2Y = L.GROUND_Y - ballRadius(m2);
        v1f = null;
        v2f = null;
        hasFired = false;
        winOk = false;
        animating = false;
        hintKey = 'reset';
        ov1Display.textContent = '—';
        ov2Display.textContent = '—';
        ov3Display.textContent = '未检测';
        hintMsg.textContent = '包件2尚未进区 · 调参后点发射';
        hintMsg.className = 'hint-msg';
        drawScene();
    }

    function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
        ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
        ctx.closePath();
    }

    function drawScene() {
        syncCanvasSize();
        var L = layoutMetrics();
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var GROUND_Y = L.GROUND_Y;
        var TARGET_LEFT = L.TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_RIGHT = L.TARGET_RIGHT;
        var TARGET_Y_TOP = L.TARGET_Y_TOP, TARGET_Y_BOT = L.TARGET_Y_BOT;

        var SC = { ink:'#120c12', mid:'#2e2430', hi:'#e8a8c8', glow:'#e060a0', metal:'#7a8490', accent:'#c878a0', ok:'#6fae8f' };

        // 冷色实验台背景 + 纵深
        const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
        bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a1420');
        bg.addColorStop(0.35, SC.ink);
        bg.addColorStop(0.72, '#181018');
        bg.addColorStop(1, '#0e080e');
        ctx.fillStyle = bg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var flood = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.28, H * 0.06, 6, W * 0.42, H * 0.5, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
        flood.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(232,168,200,0.18)');
        flood.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(200,120,160,0.08)');
        flood.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(18,12,18,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = flood;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        // 顶灯带（冷实验室照明）
        for (var li = 0; li < 5; li++) {
            var lx = 60 + li * (W / 5.5);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.5)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(lx, 6);
            ctx.lineTo(lx, 28);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            roundRect(lx - 12, 28, 24, 10, 3);
            ctx.fill();
            var lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, 42, 2, lx, 55, 28);
            lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(232,168,200,0.22)');
            lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(232,168,200,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = lg;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(lx, 55, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        // 后墙板 + 设备柜（吃上空）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46,36,48,0.55)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 32, W, GROUND_Y - 80);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.15)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (var pv = 0; pv < 5; pv++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(0, 50 + pv * 42);
            ctx.lineTo(W, 50 + pv * 42);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        // 右后设备柜
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2430';
        roundRect(W - 110, 118, 96, H * 0.38, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,120,160,0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('设备柜', W - 88, 136);
        for (var shelf = 0; shelf < 4; shelf++) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3440';
            ctx.fillRect(W - 100, 150 + shelf * 42, 76, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = shelf % 2 ? SC.metal : '#5a4860';
            ctx.fillRect(W - 94, 160 + shelf * 42, 28, 22);
            ctx.fillRect(W - 58, 160 + shelf * 42, 28, 22);
        }

        // 左侧气泵柜（金属质感）
        var pumpGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(8, GROUND_Y - 120, 96, GROUND_Y);
        pumpGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a4048');
        pumpGrad.addColorStop(0.5, SC.metal);
        pumpGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4a5058');
        ctx.fillStyle = pumpGrad;
        roundRect(10, GROUND_Y - 118, 86, 110, 5);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,120,160,0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.ink;
        ctx.fillRect(24, GROUND_Y - 96, 58, 26);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.accent;
        ctx.fillRect(30, GROUND_Y - 88, 22, 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('气泵', 40, GROUND_Y - 124);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(122,132,144,0.65)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(96, GROUND_Y - 48);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(120, GROUND_Y - 58, 140, GROUND_Y - 22);
        ctx.stroke();

        // 实验台地坪
        const floor = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y + 8, 0, H);
        floor.addColorStop(0, '#3a3840');
        floor.addColorStop(0.4, SC.mid);
        floor.addColorStop(1, SC.ink);
        ctx.fillStyle = floor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y + 8, W, H - GROUND_Y - 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y + 8, W, 3);

        // 加高铝轨 + 喷气孔；导轨温度只改色温雾气（不影响碰撞）
        var trackL = 36, trackR = W - 36, trackTop = GROUND_Y - 28, trackH = 32;
        var tRail = sRailTemp ? parseFloat(sRailTemp.value) : 22;
        var tN = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (tRail - 5) / 55));
        var railGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, trackTop, 0, trackTop + trackH);
        railGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(' + Math.round(154 + tN * 60) + ',' + Math.round(164 - tN * 40) + ',' + Math.round(174 - tN * 70) + ')');
        railGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgb(' + Math.round(200 + tN * 30) + ',' + Math.round(208 - tN * 50) + ',' + Math.round(216 - tN * 90) + ')');
        railGrad.addColorStop(0.55, SC.metal);
        railGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a626a');
        ctx.fillStyle = railGrad;
        roundRect(trackL, trackTop, trackR - trackL, trackH, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,168,200,0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,168,200,0.45)';
        for (var p = trackL + 14; p < trackR - 10; p += 16) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(p, GROUND_Y - 6, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,168,200,0.06)';
        ctx.fillRect(trackL + 4, trackTop - 8, trackR - trackL - 8, 6);
        if (tN > 0.08) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,' + Math.round(200 - tN * 80) + ',' + Math.round(160 - tN * 80) + ',' + (0.04 + tN * 0.12) + ')';
            ctx.fillRect(trackL + 2, trackTop - 14, trackR - trackL - 4, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,200,160,' + (0.35 + tN * 0.4) + ')';
            ctx.font = '10px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('导轨 ' + tRail.toFixed(0) + '°C', trackR - 72, trackTop - 16);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6268';
        ctx.fillRect(trackL - 6, GROUND_Y + 2, 14, 28);
        ctx.fillRect(trackR - 8, GROUND_Y + 2, 14, 28);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('气垫导轨台', trackL + 8, trackTop - 10);

        // 光电门区（与终点几何对齐）
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(111,174,143,0.12)';
        ctx.fillRect(TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_Y_TOP, TARGET_RIGHT - TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_Y_BOT - TARGET_Y_TOP);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(111,174,143,0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_Y_TOP, TARGET_RIGHT - TARGET_LEFT, TARGET_Y_BOT - TARGET_Y_TOP);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.metal;
        ctx.fillRect(TARGET_LEFT + 2, TARGET_Y_TOP + 6, 5, TARGET_Y_BOT - TARGET_Y_TOP - 12);
        ctx.fillRect(TARGET_RIGHT - 7, TARGET_Y_TOP + 6, 5, TARGET_Y_BOT - TARGET_Y_TOP - 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.ok;
        ctx.fillRect(TARGET_LEFT + 4, TARGET_Y_TOP + 4, TARGET_RIGHT - TARGET_LEFT - 8, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(playMode === 'challenge' ? '竞赛光电门' : '光电门', TARGET_LEFT + 10, TARGET_Y_TOP - 6);

        var r1 = ballRadius(m1), r2 = ballRadius(m2);
        if (!animating && !hasFired) {
            ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X;
            ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X;
            ball1Y = GROUND_Y - r1;
            ball2Y = GROUND_Y - r2;
        }

        function drawBlock(x, y, r, fill, stroke, label) {
            var rr = r * 1.25;
            roundRect(x - rr, y - rr * 0.75, rr * 2, rr * 1.55, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = fill;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
            roundRect(x - rr + 4, y - rr * 0.55, rr * 0.7, rr * 0.45, 3);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(label, x, y + 5);
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        }
        drawBlock(ball1X, ball1Y, r1, '#5a7898', SC.hi, '1');
        drawBlock(ball2X, ball2Y, r2, SC.accent, '#f0b0c8', '2');

        // 初速 / 动量箭头；碰撞火花
        if (!hasFired) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            var ax = ball1X + r1 + 8;
            var ay = ball1Y - r1 - 14;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
            ctx.lineTo(ax + 36 + v1 * 5, ay);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ax + 36 + v1 * 5, ay);
            ctx.lineTo(ax + 26 + v1 * 5, ay - 6);
            ctx.lineTo(ax + 26 + v1 * 5, ay + 6);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.font = '12px "Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('p₁→', ax + 6, ay - 8);
        }
        if (animating && Math.abs(ball1X - ball2X) < (r1 + r2) * 2.2) {
            var sx = (ball1X + ball2X) / 2, sy = (ball1Y + ball2Y) / 2;
            var collSpeed = Math.abs(v1 - v2);
            var speedNorm = Math.min(1, collSpeed / 8);
            var sparkN = 4 + Math.floor(speedNorm * 10);
            var sparkLen = 12 + speedNorm * 22;
            // 撞击暖闪
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,100,' + (0.15 + speedNorm * 0.35) + ')';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy, 8 + speedNorm * 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            for (var sp = 0; sp < sparkN; sp++) {
                var sa = (sp / sparkN) * Math.PI * 2;
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,120,' + (0.55 + speedNorm * 0.4) + ')';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + speedNorm * 1.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
                ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.cos(sa) * sparkLen, sy + Math.sin(sa) * (sparkLen * 0.75));
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,160,' + (0.7 + speedNorm * 0.3) + ')';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy, 4 + speedNorm * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        if (hasFired && !animating && v1f !== null) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = SC.glow;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ball1X, ball1Y - r1 - 20);
            ctx.lineTo(ball1X + v1f * 18, ball1Y - r1 - 20);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ball2X, ball2Y - r2 - 20);
            ctx.lineTo(ball2X + v2f * 18, ball2Y - r2 - 20);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        if (hasFired && !animating && v1f !== null) {
            roundRect(16, H - 72, 148, 48, 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,12,18,0.88)';
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,120,160,0.45)';
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = SC.hi;
            ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace,Consolas,sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.fillText(`v₁' = ${v1f.toFixed(2)} m/s`, 28, H - 52);
            ctx.fillText(`v₂' = ${v2f.toFixed(2)} m/s`, 28, H - 34);
        }
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    function fire() {
        if (animating) return;
        readControls();
        syncCanvasSize();
        var L = layoutMetrics();
        var r1 = ballRadius(m1), r2 = ballRadius(m2);
        ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X;
        ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X;
        ball1Y = L.GROUND_Y - r1;
        ball2Y = L.GROUND_Y - r2;

        const result = computeCollision(m1, m2, v1, v2);
        v1f = result.v1f;
        v2f = result.v2f;

        let collisionTime = 0;
        let collided = false;
        if (v1 > v2) {
            const dx = (ball2X - ball1X - r1 - r2) / L.PX_PER_M;
            const dv = v1 - v2;
            if (dv > 0 && dx > 0) {
                collisionTime = dx / dv;
                collided = true;
            }
        }

        const postTime = 0.65;
        let end1, end2;
        if (collided && collisionTime > 0) {
            const c1 = L.BALL1_INIT_X + v1 * collisionTime * L.PX_PER_M;
            const c2 = L.BALL2_INIT_X + v2 * collisionTime * L.PX_PER_M;
            end1 = c1 + v1f * postTime * L.PX_PER_M;
            end2 = c2 + v2f * postTime * L.PX_PER_M;
        } else {
            // 不相撞：各自按初速匀速一小段（v2=0 时物块2保持静止）
            v1f = v1;
            v2f = v2;
            collisionTime = 0;
            const t = 0.55;
            end1 = L.BALL1_INIT_X + v1 * t * L.PX_PER_M;
            end2 = L.BALL2_INIT_X + v2 * t * L.PX_PER_M;
        }
        function clampX(x, r) {
            if (x > W - r) return W - r;
            if (x < r) return r;
            return x;
        }
        end1 = clampX(end1, r1);
        end2 = clampX(end2, r2);

        const inTarget = (end2 >= L.TARGET_LEFT && end2 <= L.TARGET_RIGHT);
        winOk = inTarget;
        hasFired = true;
        animating = true;

        // 末速与进区结果在动画结束后再揭示（过程中侧栏保持 —）
        ov1Display.textContent = '—';
        ov2Display.textContent = '—';
        ov3Display.textContent = '运动中…';
        hintKey = winOk ? 'win' : (collided ? 'collide_no_win' : 'no_collide');
        hintMsg.textContent = collided ? '包件1前冲 · 接触后分配速度…' : '包件1前冲中…';
        hintMsg.className = 'hint-msg';

        ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X;
        ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X;
        let t0 = null;
        const totalDur = collided
          ? Math.max(0.35, collisionTime) + postTime
          : 0.55;
        function step(ts) {
            if (!t0) t0 = ts;
            const elapsed = Math.min(totalDur, (ts - t0) / 1000);
            if (collided && collisionTime > 0) {
                if (elapsed < collisionTime) {
                    // 碰前：仅按初速运动；v2=0 时物块2静止
                    ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X + v1 * elapsed * L.PX_PER_M;
                    ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X + v2 * elapsed * L.PX_PER_M;
                } else {
                    const te = elapsed - collisionTime;
                    const c1 = L.BALL1_INIT_X + v1 * collisionTime * L.PX_PER_M;
                    const c2 = L.BALL2_INIT_X + v2 * collisionTime * L.PX_PER_M;
                    ball1X = c1 + v1f * te * L.PX_PER_M;
                    ball2X = c2 + v2f * te * L.PX_PER_M;
                }
            } else {
                ball1X = L.BALL1_INIT_X + v1 * elapsed * L.PX_PER_M;
                ball2X = L.BALL2_INIT_X + v2 * elapsed * L.PX_PER_M;
            }
            ball1X = clampX(ball1X, r1);
            ball2X = clampX(ball2X, r2);
            ball1Y = L.GROUND_Y - r1;
            ball2Y = L.GROUND_Y - r2;
            drawScene();
            if (elapsed < totalDur) requestAnimationFrame(step);
            else {
                animating = false;
                ball1X = end1;
                ball2X = end2;
                ov1Display.textContent = v1f.toFixed(2);
                ov2Display.textContent = v2f.toFixed(2);
                ov3Display.textContent = winOk ? '已进入' : '未进入';
                if (winOk) {
                    hintMsg.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
                      ? '包件2进入急单接货口！投递成功！'
                      : '包件2进入接货口。再试一次未进区的参数作对比。';
                    hintMsg.className = 'hint-msg win-msg';
                } else if (collided) {
                    const missSide = end2 < L.TARGET_LEFT ? '偏近（口左侧）' : '偏远（口右侧）';
                    hintMsg.textContent = playMode === 'challenge'
                      ? ('碰撞后' + missSide + '，口位不变，对照停距再调参…')
                      : ('碰撞已发生，包件2' + missSide + '，请对照接货口调参');
                    hintMsg.className = 'hint-msg fail-msg';
                    hintKey = end2 < L.TARGET_LEFT ? 'miss_short' : 'miss_long';
                } else {
                    hintMsg.textContent = '尚未相撞 · 可增大包件1相对速度后再发射';
                    hintMsg.className = 'hint-msg fail-msg';
                }
                drawScene();
                const controlsSnapshot = {
                    's-mass1': sMass1.value,
                    's-mass2': sMass2.value,
                    's-vel1': sVel1.value,
                    's-vel2': sVel2.value
                };
                if (playMode === 'challenge') {
                  if (winOk) {
                    if (!challengeWon) {
                      challengeWon = true;
                      emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: true, hintKey: 'mom_rush' });
                      emit('win', { winOk: true });
                      if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                        window.__craftShowWin('急单接货口本局锁定，你用动量守恒把包件2投进了指定口位。');
                      }
                    }
                  } else {
                    emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: hintKey });
                    // FixedChallenge：失败不换口，只复位再试
                    sVel1.value = '2.0';
                    sMass1.value = '1.0';
                    sMass2.value = '1.5';
                    sVel2.value = '0.0';
                    updateSliderLabels();
                    resetSim(true);
                    refreshGoalUI();
                    hintMsg.textContent = '未投进 · 接货口仍在约 ' + Math.round(targetCenterFrac * 100) + '% 处（本局固定）';
                  }
                  return;
                }
                exploreShots += 1;
                if (winOk) sawIn = true; else sawMiss = true;
                emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: false, hintKey: hintKey });
                if (!exploreWon && exploreShots >= 3 && sawIn && sawMiss) {
                  exploreWon = true;
                  hintMsg.textContent = '已见过进区与未进 · 可切换竞赛接急单（口位本局固定）';
                  emit('snapshot', { controls: controlsSnapshot, winOk: true, hintKey: 'mom_explore' });
                  emit('win', { winOk: true });
                  if (typeof window.__craftShowWin === 'function') {
                    window.__craftShowWin('你通过对比进区与未进，归纳了一维碰撞中的动量分配规律。');
                  }
                }
            }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    function emit(type, payload) {
        try {
            if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
            if (window.parent && window.parent !== window && window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter) {
                window.parent.PlatformTraceAdapter.record(type, payload || {});
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function snapControls() {
        var o = {};
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
            var id = el.id || el.name; if (id) o[id] = el.value;
        });
        return o;
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        emit('puzzle_open', {});
        document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"], input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el) {
            el.addEventListener('change', function() {
                if (window.__platformTraceControlsBound) return;
                emit('tuning', { control: el.id || el.name || 'slider', value: el.value });
            });
        });
        var i1 = document.getElementById('I1');
        if (i1) {
            i1.addEventListener('change', function() {
                emit('irrelevant_touch', { control: 'I1', value: i1.value });
            });
        }
    });

    updateSliderLabels();
    refreshGoalUI();
    resetSim(true);
    drawScene();
    window.__momRedraw = drawScene;

    sMass1.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSliderLabels(); resetSim(true); });
    sMass2.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSliderLabels(); resetSim(true); });
    sVel1.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSliderLabels(); resetSim(true); });
    sVel2.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSliderLabels(); resetSim(true); });
    if (sRailTemp) sRailTemp.addEventListener('input', function() { updateSliderLabels(); });
    btnFire.addEventListener('click', fire);
    btnReset.addEventListener('click', function() { resetSim(true); emit('snapshot', { controls: snapControls(), winOk: false, hintKey: 'manual_reset' }); });

    window.__physics = { computeCollision, fire, resetSim };
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  function emitWin(hintKey) {
    if (window.__legacyWinEmitted) return;
    window.__legacyWinEmitted = true;
    var emit = window.__emit;
    if (!emit) return;
    var controls = window.__snapControls ? window.__snapControls() : {};
    emit('snapshot', { controls: controls, winOk: true, hintKey: hintKey || 'legacy_win' });
    emit('win', { winOk: true });
  }
  var WIN_TEXT = [/完美命中/, /游戏胜利/, /过关！/, /命中目标！/, /🎯\s*命中目标/, /🏆\s*过关/];
  function scanWinText() {
    var text = document.body ? document.body.innerText : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < WIN_TEXT.length; i++) {
      if (WIN_TEXT[i].test(text)) {
        emitWin('text_' + i);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { scanWinText(); });
    if (document.body) obs.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true });
    setInterval(scanWinText, 800);
  });
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__essenceStageResize) return;
  window.__essenceStageResize = true;
  function fit(){
    if (typeof window.__momRedraw === 'function') {
      window.__momRedraw();
      return;
    }
    var stage = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    var cvs = stage && stage.querySelector('canvas');
    if (!stage || !cvs) return;
    var w = stage.clientWidth, h = stage.clientHeight;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2) return;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
    var st = document.getElementById('essence-stage');
    if (st) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(st);
  }
  fit();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* === dual-mode-shell runtime (auto) === */
(function(){
  if (window.__dualModeShell) return;
  window.__dualModeShell = true;

  var MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
  var EXPLORE_SECONDS = 10 * 60;
  var state = {
    mode: 'explore',
    attempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    timeLeft: EXPLORE_SECONDS,
    timerId: null
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }

  function setPhase(phase){
    try {
      if (typeof window.__platformTraceSetPhase === 'function') {
        window.__platformTraceSetPhase(phase);
      } else if (window.PlatformTraceAdapter && typeof window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase === 'function') {
        window.PlatformTraceAdapter.setPhase(phase);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* offline */ }
  }

  function fmt(sec){
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    var s = sec % 60;
    return (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ':' + (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s;
  }

  function renderAttempts(){
    var el = $('attemptsDisplay');
    if (el) el.textContent = String(state.attempts);
  }

  function primaryButtons(){
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
      '#essence-bench .essence-ft button, #essence-bench button.btn, #essence-bench button[id^="btn"]'
    ));
  }

  function gateActions(){
    var disable = state.mode === 'challenge' && state.attempts <= 0;
    primaryButtons().forEach(function(btn){
      if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(btn.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(btn.id || '')) return;
      btn.classList.toggle('dual-disabled', disable);
      if (disable) btn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
      else btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
    });
  }

  function stopTimer(){
    if (state.timerId) { clearInterval(state.timerId); state.timerId = null; }
  }

  function startExploreTimer(){
    stopTimer();
    state.timeLeft = EXPLORE_SECONDS;
    var td = $('timerDisplay');
    if (td) td.textContent = fmt(state.timeLeft);
    state.timerId = setInterval(function(){
      if (state.mode !== 'explore') return;
      state.timeLeft -= 1;
      if (td) td.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.timeLeft));
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        stopTimer();
        var sel = $('modeSelect');
        if (sel) {
          sel.value = 'challenge';
          sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  function applyMode(mode){
    state.mode = mode === 'challenge' ? 'challenge' : 'explore';
    var label = $('modeLabel');
    var stats = $('challengeStats');
    var timerChip = $('dual-timer-chip');
    if (label) label.textContent = state.mode === 'explore' ? '探究模式' : '竞赛模式';
    if (stats) {
      if (state.mode === 'challenge') stats.classList.add('is-visible');
      else stats.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
    if (timerChip) timerChip.style.display = state.mode === 'explore' ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (state.mode === 'challenge') {
      stopTimer();
      state.attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS;
      renderAttempts();
    } else {
      startExploreTimer();
    }
    setPhase(state.mode);
    gateActions();
    if (typeof window.__momApplyMode === 'function') {
      try { window.__momApplyMode(state.mode); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function onPrimaryClick(e){
    if (state.mode !== 'challenge') return;
    var t = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!t) return;
    if (/reset|清除|重置|再来/i.test(t.textContent || '') || /reset|clear/i.test(t.id || '')) return;
    if (state.attempts <= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }
    state.attempts -= 1;
    renderAttempts();
    gateActions();
  }

  function ensureUi(){
    var stage = $('essence-stage') || document.querySelector('#proj-stage, #stage, #canvasContainer, .canvas-wrap')?.parentElement;
    var bench = $('essence-bench');
    if (!stage) return false;

    if (!$('dual-mode-hud')) {
      var hud = document.createElement('div');
      hud.id = 'dual-mode-hud';
      hud.innerHTML =
        '<div id="dual-timer-chip" class="dual-chip">' +
          '<span id="modeLabel">探究模式</span><span style="width:1px;height:14px;background:#cbd5e1"></span>' +
          '<span id="timerDisplay">10:00</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="challengeStats"><span>剩余机会</span><span id="attemptsDisplay">5</span></div>';
      stage.style.position = stage.style.position || 'relative';
      stage.appendChild(hud);
    }

    if (bench && !$('modeSelect')) {
      bench.classList.add('dual-mode-ready');
      var hd = document.createElement('div');
      hd.id = 'essence-bench-hd';
      hd.className = 'dual-bench-hd';
      var title = '环境控制台';
      var tEl = stage.querySelector('.essence-title, h1');
      if (tEl) title = (tEl.textContent || title).trim() || title;
      hd.innerHTML =
        '<h1>' + title.replace(/</g,'<') + '</h1>' +
        '<select id="modeSelect" aria-label="探究阶段">' +
          '<option value="explore">自由探究</option>' +
          '<option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>' +
        '</select>';
      bench.insertBefore(hd, bench.firstChild);
    } else if (!$('modeSelect')) {
      // Fallback: floating select in hud
      var chip = $('dual-timer-chip');
      if (chip && !$('modeSelect')) {
        var sel = document.createElement('select');
        sel.id = 'modeSelect';
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="explore">自由探究</option><option value="challenge">竞赛挑战</option>';
        chip.appendChild(sel);
      }
    }
    return !!$('modeSelect');
  }

  function boot(){
    if (!ensureUi()) return;
    var sel = $('modeSelect');
    sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ applyMode(sel.value); });
    var ft = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .essence-ft') || $('essence-bench') || document.body;
    ft.addEventListener('click', onPrimaryClick, true);
    applyMode(sel.value || 'explore');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>


<script>
/* === craft-gold-runtime === */
(function(){
  if (window.__craftGold) return; window.__craftGold = true;
  var intro = document.getElementById('craft-intro');
  var win = document.getElementById('craft-win');
  var btn = document.getElementById('craftIntroBtn');
  var wbtn = document.getElementById('craftWinBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(intro) intro.hidden = true; });
  function replayLevel(){
    if (typeof window.__craftReplay === 'function') {
      try { window.__craftReplay(); return; } catch (e) {}
    }
    var rbtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset')
      || document.querySelector('#btnReset, button.btn-reset, [data-action="reset"]');
    if (rbtn) { try { rbtn.click(); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  if (wbtn) wbtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    window.__craftWinDismissed = true;
    if (win) win.hidden = true;
    replayLevel();
  });

  // gauge into hud
  var hud = document.getElementById('essence-hud') || document.getElementById('dual-mode-hud') || document.getElementById('hud');
  if (hud && !document.getElementById('craft-gauge')) {
    var g = document.createElement('div');
    g.id = 'craft-gauge';
    g.innerHTML = '<span>目标仪表</span><strong id="craftGaugeVal">待测</strong>';
    hud.appendChild(g);
  }
function showWin(extra){
    if (win) {
      window.__craftWinDismissed = false;
      win.hidden = false;
      var t = document.getElementById('craftWinText');
      if (t && extra) t.textContent = extra;
    }
  }
  window.__craftShowWin = showWin;

  // Hook common win paths
  var _emit = window.__emit;
  window.__emit = function(type, payload){
    if (typeof _emit === 'function') _emit(type, payload);
    if (type === 'win') showWin();
  };
  // Observe win banners
  var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){
    if (window.__craftWinDismissed) return;
    var el = document.querySelector('.win-banner,.win-badge,#winBanner,[data-win="1"]');
    if (el && el.offsetParent !== null) showWin();
  });
  obs.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','style','hidden']});

  // Live gauge from first range readout if possible
  function tick(){
    var val = document.querySelector('#essence-bench .value-badge, #essence-bench .value, .observe-box .state, .observe-value, #craftGaugeVal');
    var src = document.querySelector('.observe-box .state, .observe-value, #hud-dist, #g-T, .gauge .gval');
    var gval = document.getElementById('craftGaugeVal');
    if (gval && src && src !== gval) gval.textContent = (src.textContent || '').trim() || '观测中';
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>
